items.text:
This is that rare case where a Neutral recommendation would fit perfectly. I marked it as No, but that is not a negative verdict. I like the game a lot — I just want other buyers to know what they are stepping into. I have 250+ hours in it, and I have barely flown outside the starting OKLG area. I had so much fun there that I stayed… and that is exactly where the current shortcomings became obvious.

The good (short list — it is a decent game, so these are the standouts):

- A great, hardcore space sim with a lot of freedom
- Excellent start: character creation and the mortgage make the opening hours properly challenging
- Solid shipbuilding, including bits you can scavenge from derelicts
- A scavenger economy that actually hurts. You feel it when a part is missing, the nearby station does not have it, and you have to cut and sell a liver to afford it
- You pay for everything — including the ability to take a breath
- Flying through a customizable navigation panel. Painful at first, and it takes getting used to, but it is a genuinely good idea

What you have to be ready for - negatives -  (the longer list — this is why I stopped where I did, hoping for a better experience later):

- It may be labelled 1.0, but it does not feel like it, especially on optimisation. After the last patch, the OKLG docking area has about 3× as many NPCs, and the game slows down badly. Running at 4× while retrofitting ships is basically undoable. UI is not decoupled from simulation either: when it stutters, you cannot even pause. That suggests little or no multithreading.
- Task ordering. You can queue work for yourself or a small crew (I never got far with crew; I used my main character and a task list, which is far more efficient than doing jobs one by one). With a large queue — for example stripping a whole derelict — tasks run line by line, top-down or bottom-up, instead of nearest-next. I assume the task creator just scans in vertical rows. The result is a lot of wasted walking when the character starts a new “line.”
- No mass task cancel. If you realise mid-way you made a mistake, you delete jobs one by one. That can mean a few hundred clicks. We already have an Orders “painter.” A cancel painter would be an obvious next step.
I completely accept hand-managing the ship at the start: scrap hull, scavenge, patch, refill O2 bottles for EVA suits, manually fill N2/O2 canisters outside a station. Later, though, I expected access to more expensive, higher-tier gear that automates some of this — EVA bottle refill stations, piping so scavenged N2 canisters can feed a refill network, popping installed canisters from barrels, and especially automatic pressure detection.
- Automatic hauling is atrocious, including installing parts on the ship. Characters often keep dragging an item even after that item’s job is already supplied — sometimes by the same character. They deliver a few pieces, start dragging a wall, then freeze because there is “no space” to carry the next thing.
- Wall building assumes a perfectly clean space. The character will not clear debris first. You babysit and micromanage, or the job fails.
- Hauling to designated areas is a mess. Items often end up outside the zone, or even outside the ship, behind the walls. Typical haul-order behaviour: (1) they carry items one by one, or only a few similar ones, well below capacity; (2) they drag an item to the drop point, then happily drag it back while going for the next one; (3) they take things from your haul area and dump them back on the derelict they were supposed to empty. This was the last straw. If I had an NPC crew making that kind of mess, I would rage-space them without EVA suits.
- Character dialogue is bad. I know the game is task-based, but conversations do not fit that model (wait, reply, wait, reply). Combat is the same: task commands you have to repeat on the target. The command order also changes, so I mixed up “slap” and “stab” more than once.
- Micro-asteroids are frustrating — not because they exist. For a project this realistic, they belong. The problem is I found myself repairing the exact same spot up to eight times in a row while stripping a derelict. Hits have no graduated damage: they always shred wall + floor + circuits to the breaking point, never halfway.
- Floor and wall strength barely matter. Weight is the only value that counts. Heavier “luxury” parts and more militaristic ones are just role-play.
- The building app desperately needs parts grouped by family instead of one long list.
- A ship cargo manifest is a must. I cannot remember whether I have 110 or 210 floor pieces when collecting for a retrofit.
- Fusion-reactor logistics (the large canisters) really need pipelines — a proper pumping system, and a way to refill HE3 from scavenged canisters. Water is the same: no plumbing; you still haul bottles to sinks.
- Relatively little part variation. There is a lot of equipment, but each piece has one job. You rarely get competing tiers (air pump vs turbo air pump, normal intake vs Hydra intake). Stats are also thin: power draw while working vs idle, and so on.
- Characters swapping batteries in devices or EVA suits tend to dump stuff on the floor. I have also seen them forget to swap EVA batteries or O2 bottles while working, then stand there gasping.
- Your PDA could use some app to remote control stuff. We already have signal boxes, would be great to have ability to trigger them from PDA. Also when on derelict you have no remote access to you own Nav station, so even if you get some signal about some event, you can't check anything until you back into you ship "map"
- Considering how fast you can get rick with meat and scavenged cargo holds... we need more equipment in various price ranges or more difficult / time-consuming repairs (which would require more durability in exchange). My last save was about 5.6MLN, without flying of OKLG - starting area. I just happen to land on very HEAVILY infested ship so I played the butcher.
- And more I have forgotten for now.

This is a great idea wrapped in a lot of small frustrations. Nothing is fundamentally broken, and playing is fun — until you get tired of fighting the systems. A lot of this could be mods; the Workshop already has several attempts. I get the feeling the codebase is still in flux, though, so a mod that works today may not survive the next patch.

If you can live with the above, you will have a great time. I did — especially in the first 100 hours. After that I started hitting walls: the automation I'd  expect as I progress is not there, and it looks like I will have to micromanage everything forever. Definitely not wasted time. Just a bit disappointed.
items.text_zh:
这是那种罕见的情况，一个“中立”推荐会完美契合。我把它标记为“不推荐”，但那并不是负面评价。我非常喜欢这款游戏——我只是想让其他买家知道他们要面对什么。我在里面已经玩了250多个小时，而我几乎没有飞出过起始的OKLG区域。我在那里玩得太开心了，所以就留了下来……而正是在那里，当前的缺点变得显而易见。

优点（简短列表——这是一款不错的游戏，所以这些是突出之处）：

- 一款出色、硬核且自由度很高的太空模拟游戏
- 极佳的开局：角色创建和房贷让最初几个小时的挑战性恰到好处
- 扎实的造船系统，包括可以从废弃飞船中打捞到的零件
- 一种真的会让你感到肉痛的拾荒经济。当缺少一个零件、附近空间站又没有、而你不得不割下一个肝卖掉才买得起时，你能真切感受到这一点
- 一切都要花钱——包括呼吸的能力
- 通过可自定义的导航面板飞行。起初很痛苦，也需要时间适应，但这确实是个好主意

你必须准备好面对的事——缺点——（更长的列表——这就是我为什么停在了当时那个进度，希望以后能有更好的体验）：

- 它可能被标为1.0，但感觉并不像，尤其是在优化方面。上次补丁之后，OKLG停靠区大约多了3倍的NPC，游戏严重变慢。改装飞船时以4倍速运行基本没法玩。UI也没有与模拟解耦：卡顿时，你甚至无法暂停。这说明多线程很少或根本没有。
- 任务排序。你可以为自己或一个小船员队列安排工作（我从未在船员方面走得很远；我用主角和一个任务列表，这比一件件做工作高效得多）。当队列很大时——例如拆解一整艘废弃飞船——任务会按行、自上而下或自下而上运行，而不是按最近的下一个执行。我猜任务创建器只是按垂直行扫描。结果是，当角色开始新的一“行”时，会浪费大量走路时间。
- 没有批量取消任务。如果你中途意识到自己犯了错，就只能一个个删除工作。那可能意味着几百次点击。我们已经有了订单“画笔”。取消画笔显然是下一步。
我完全接受开局时手动管理飞船：刮船体、拾荒、修补、为EVA服补充O2瓶、在空间站外手动填充N2/O2罐。但后来，我期待能获得更昂贵、更高档的装备来自动化其中一些事情——EVA瓶补充站、让打捞来的N2罐接入补充网络的管道、从桶中取出已安装的罐，尤其是自动压力检测。
- 自动搬运糟糕透顶，包括在飞船上安装零件。角色常常在该物品的工作已经被供给之后还继续拖着它——有时还是同一个角色。他们送了几件东西，开始拖一堵墙，然后因为“没有空间”携带下一件东西而卡住。
- 建造墙壁假定空间完全干净。角色不会先清理碎片。你要么像保姆一样微观管理，要么工作失败。
- 搬运到指定区域一团糟。物品常常最终落在区域外，甚至飞船外、墙后面。典型的搬运命令行为：（1）他们一件件搬，或者只搬几件相似的，远低于容量；（2）他们把物品拖到投放点，然后在去拿下一件时又高高兴兴地把它拖回去；（3）他们从你的搬运区拿东西，然后丢回本该清空的废弃飞船上。这是最后一根稻草。如果我有一个NPC船员制造这种烂摊子，我会气得把他们不穿EVA服就扔进太空。
- 角色对话很糟糕。我知道游戏是基于任务的，但对话并不符合那种模式（等待、回复、等待、回复）。战斗也一样：你必须对目标重复下达任务命令。命令顺序还会变化，所以我不止一次把“扇耳光”和“刺”搞混。
- 微型小行星很烦人——不是因为它们存在。对于这样一个追求真实感的项目来说，它们本就该有。问题是在拆解一艘废弃飞船时，我发现自己连续修复同一个位置多达八次。撞击没有渐进式损伤：它们总是把墙+地板+电路撕到崩溃边缘，从来不会只损坏一半。
- 地板和墙壁的强度几乎无关紧要。重量才是唯一重要的数值。更重的“豪华”部件和更军事化的部件只是角色扮演。
- 建造应用迫切需要按类别分组零件，而不是一个长长的列表。
- 飞船货物清单是必须的。在为改装收集材料时，我记不住自己是有110块还是210块地板件。
- 聚变反应堆物流（大型罐）真的需要管道——一个正经的泵送系统，以及从打捞来的罐中补充HE3的方法。水也一样：没有管道；你仍然要把瓶子搬到水槽。
- 零件变化相对很少。设备很多，但每件只有一个用途。你很少看到相互竞争的档次（空气泵 vs 涡轮空气泵，普通进气口 vs 海德拉进气口）。属性也很单薄：工作时与空闲时的耗电等等。
- 角色在设备或EVA服中更换电池时，往往会把东西丢在地上。我还见过他们在工作时忘记更换EVA电池或O2瓶，然后站在那里喘气。
- 你的PDA可以加一些远程控制东西的应用。我们已经有信号盒了，如果能从PDA触发它们会很棒。另外，在废弃飞船上时，你无法远程访问自己的导航站，所以即使你收到某个事件的信号，也要回到飞船“地图”才能查看任何东西。
- 考虑到用肉和打捞来的货舱能多快变富……我们需要更多不同价位的设备，或者更困难/更耗时的修理（作为交换，这需要更高的耐久度）。我上一个存档大约有560万，还没飞出OKLG——起始区域。我只是碰巧降落在一艘感染极其严重的飞船上，于是当起了屠夫。
- 还有更多我现在已经忘了的。

这是一个伟大的点子，包裹在许多小小的挫败感之中。没有什么根本性的损坏，玩起来也很有趣——直到你厌倦了与各种系统作斗争。其中很多本可以做成mod；创意工坊已经有几次尝试了。不过我感觉代码库仍在变动，所以今天能用的mod可能撑不过下一个补丁。

如果你能忍受上述问题，你会玩得很开心。我就是这样——尤其是在最初的100个小时里。之后我开始撞墙：我期望随着进度获得的自动化并不存在，而且看起来我将不得不永远微观管理一切。绝对不是浪费时间。只是有点失望。
你的搬运区域，然后把它们扔回本该被清空的废弃飞船上。这是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。如果我有一队NPC船员搞出这种烂摊子，我会不给他们穿EVA服就把他们扔进太空。
- 角色对话很糟糕。我知道这游戏是基于任务的，但对话并不适合那种模式（等待、回复、等待、回复）。战斗也一样：你必须在目标身上重复下达任务指令。指令顺序还会变，所以我不止一次把“扇耳光”和“捅刺”搞混了。
- 微型小行星很烦人——不是因为它们存在。对于一个如此写实的项目来说，它们本就该有。问题在于，我在拆解一艘废弃飞船时，发现自己最多连续八次修理同一个位置。撞击没有渐进式损伤：它们总是把墙壁+地板+电路直接撕到报废边缘，从来不会只损坏一半。
- 地板和墙壁的强度几乎无关紧要。重量才是唯一重要的数值。更重的“豪华”部件和更军事化的部件都只是角色扮演。
- 建造应用迫切需要按部件族系分组，而不是一个长长的列表。
- 飞船货物清单是必须的。在为改装收集材料时，我记不清自己是有110块还是210块地板。
- 聚变反应堆物流（那些大罐子）真的需要管道——一套正经的泵送系统，以及从捡来的罐子里补充HE3的方法。水也一样：没有管道；你还是得把瓶子搬到水槽边。
- 部件种类相对较少。设备很多，但每件只有一个用途。你很少能看到相互竞争的层级（空气泵 vs 涡轮空气泵，普通进气口 vs 海德拉进气口）。属性也很单薄：工作时与待机时的功耗，等等。
- 角色在设备或EVA服里换电池时，往往会把东西丢在地上。我还见过他们在工作时忘记更换EVA电池或O2瓶，然后站在那里喘气。
- 你的PDA可以加个应用来远程控制东西。我们已经有信号盒了，能从PDA触发它们会很好。另外，在废弃飞船上时，你无法远程访问自己的导航站，所以即使你收到某个事件的信号，也得回到飞船的“地图”里才能查看任何东西。
- 考虑到靠卖肉和捡来的货舱能多快变富……我们需要更多不同价位的设备，或者更困难/更耗时的修理（这反过来又需要更高的耐久度）。我上一个存档大约有560万，还没飞出OKLG——起始区域。我只是碰巧降落在一艘被严重感染的飞船上，所以我就当起了屠夫。
- 还有更多我暂时忘了的。

这是一个很棒的点子，包裹在大量小挫折里。没有什么根本性的损坏，玩起来也很有趣——直到你厌倦了和这些系统较劲。其中很多可以做成模组；创意工坊里已经有几次尝试了。不过我感觉代码库仍在变动中，所以今天能用的模组可能撑不过下一个补丁。

如果你能忍受以上这些，你会玩得很开心。我就是这样——尤其是在最初的100小时里。之后我开始撞墙：我期望随着进度推进而出现的自动化并不存在，看起来我将不得不永远事无巨细地管理一切。绝对不算浪费时间。只是有点失望。

items.text:
I tried a session years ago (around 5 hrs). UI gave some problems, so I decided to put it off, until they finished the game. Well, it's 1.0, another 5 hrs, and oh boy.

While some of the UI issues have gotten better, UI is still illegible in many ways. Why are some items "pristine" and others not?  It obviously isn't item durability, as I have seen pristine items that have been torn apart down to 30% or less. Repairing it to full, 100% doesn't make it either. No rhyme or reason. Then there is how little oversight one has over what each stat does, what your traits do, what your skills do, etc. Sure I can see that over time I do repairs quicker, I install and uninstall items quicker, after some time. But there is nothing telling me why that is. If not for the wiki, I would have no clue what "security threshold" even means.

Speaking of the wiki, it felt like a shot in the nuts, when I discovered that a 1.0 game has so little variety. Ok, you upgrade from a screwdriver to a power tool. What's next? This is 50 years in the future. The one upgrade path, that is somewhat fully developed is the one that is about structure cutting. You go from a hacksaw, to an angle grinder, to a laser torch. Everything else? 2 or even just 1 tool only. The PDA neglect is the worst part of it. There are multiple cartriges that you are supposed to be able to slot in. Two slots only though. But over 5 cards. So you are stuck constantly switching around, depending on what you need to be able to see at that moment. These are just the tools you use directly.  

What about the ship? You use the same nav console that EVERYONE USES. There is only one. You use the exact same thruster, so on and so forth. There are only two items that actually have some variety: sensors and floors/walls. You are able to choose from around 10 sensors and there are, what feels like, over 40+ floor tiles. You also get some choice in clothing (which doesn't matter, because you spend so much time doing EVA anyways, thus you aren't seeing it). To be clear, this wouldn't be an issue, if everyone item wasn't branded with a manufacturer label. Rimworlod has one console and nobody cares. But when you have "Polaris "Standard Navigation Console" Nav Station" as your nav console, well then suddenly it becomes a question of why nobody else is in that business.  There are multiple tool businesses, why not multiple nav consoles?

Overall game progression feels grindy and tedious, while also being rather straightforward and linear. Would not recommend.
items.text_zh:
我几年前试玩过一次（大约5小时）。UI出了一些问题，所以我决定推迟，等他们完成游戏再说。好吧，现在是1.0版，又玩了5小时，我的天哪。

虽然一些UI问题有所改善，但UI在很多方面仍然难以辨认。为什么有些物品是“完好”的，而另一些不是？这显然不是物品耐久度，因为我见过被拆解到30%或更低的完好物品。把它修到满，100%也不行。毫无规律可言。然后是对每个属性做什么、你的特质做什么、你的技能做什么等等，几乎没有监督。当然，我能看到随着时间推移，我修理得更快，安装和卸载物品也更快。但没有任何东西告诉我为什么。如果不是因为wiki，我根本不知道“安全阈值”是什么意思。

说到wiki，当我发现一个1.0游戏的变化如此之少时，感觉就像蛋上挨了一枪。好吧，你从螺丝刀升级到电动工具。接下来呢？这是50年后的未来。唯一一条某种程度上完整开发的升级路径，是关于结构切割的那条。你从钢锯，到角磨机，再到激光炬。其他一切呢？只有2个甚至只有1个工具。对PDA的忽视是最糟糕的部分。有多个卡带，你本应能够插入。但只有两个插槽。却有超过5张卡。所以你只能根据当时需要看到什么而不断切换。这些还只是你直接使用的工具。

那飞船呢？你使用的是每个人都使用的同一个导航控制台。只有一个。你使用完全相同的推进器，等等等等。只有两样物品真正有一些变化：传感器和地板/墙壁。你可以从大约10种传感器中选择，还有感觉超过40多种的地板砖。你在服装上也有一些选择（这无关紧要，因为你花那么多时间做EVA，所以你看不到它）。说清楚点，如果每件物品没有都贴上制造商标签，这不会是个问题。Rimworld有一个控制台，没人在乎。但当你的导航控制台是“Polaris‘标准导航控制台’导航站”时，好吧，那突然就变成了为什么没有其他公司做这个生意的问题。有多个工具企业，为什么不能有多个导航控制台？

整体游戏进程感觉既肝又乏味，同时还相当直接和线性。不推荐。

items.text:
This game released from Early Access (EA) into full release with very little content added from the beginning of EA.

There are very few ship parts, very little story, a handful of non-repeating quests, no uniqueness, nothing to explore. What you will see more than anything, is the hard-to-use build menu and the (spaceX) docking port.

In short, once you have finished your first salvage, you've experienced almost everything this game has to offer.

I could say more, but there is no reason to know more about this rather bareboned game, and that makes me sad.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏从抢先体验（EA）进入正式发布，相比EA初期几乎没有增加什么内容。

飞船部件极少，剧情极少，只有寥寥几个不重复的任务，没有独特性，没有什么可探索的。你看到最多的，就是那个难用的建造菜单和（SpaceX式的）对接端口。

简而言之，一旦你完成了第一次打捞，你就已经体验了这款游戏几乎所有的内容。

我还能说更多，但对于这款相当骨感的游戏，没有理由去了解更多，这让我感到难过。

observations.description: 建造菜单难以使用
observations.evidence: the hard-to-use build menu
observations.evidence_zh: 难用的建造菜单

items.text:
The game is rough around the edges but it can be incredibly immersive. If you're okay with suffering and are into complex simulations, you'll probably like this. If you need a game to be a polished bug-free experience, this game is not yet for you (despite the 1.0 version).

Lowlights: 
- planned walls function as real walls for pathing. took a long time staring at job cancellations to figure this one out
- no spacewalk hauling animation
- if you become wanted, the game doesn't show you why
- jobs just stall at the hauling phase after pickup sometimes
- extremely tedious to build out your ship, especially if you want coherent tiling
- art style makes it very difficult to discern objects from ship floor or ceiling bin

highlights:
- spaceflight is more fun than I would've thought from the screenshots
- music, atmosphere, backstory/writing, general ambience is great
- can pick and choose which bills to pay
- lots of content (i'm 40 hrs in and haven't made it off of kleg yet)
- good balance of complexity and playability
- good sense of progression and setback
items.text_zh:
这款游戏粗糙得很，但也能带来极强的沉浸感。如果你能忍受痛苦，又喜欢复杂的模拟游戏，你可能会喜欢它。如果你需要一款打磨精良、没有bug的游戏，那这款游戏还不适合你（尽管版本号是1.0）。

不足之处：
- 规划中的墙壁在寻路时被当作真正的墙壁。盯着任务取消看了很久才搞明白这一点
- 没有太空行走搬运的动画
- 如果你被通缉了，游戏不会告诉你原因
- 任务有时在取货后的搬运阶段就卡住了
- 建造飞船极其繁琐，尤其是如果你想要连贯的贴图
- 美术风格让人很难分辨物体和飞船地板或天花板储物箱

亮点：
- 太空飞行比我从截图里想象的有趣得多
- 音乐、氛围、背景故事/文本、整体环境都很棒
- 可以自行选择支付哪些账单
- 内容很多（我已经玩了40小时，还没离开Kleg）
- 复杂度和可玩性之间平衡得很好
- 进步和挫折感都把握得不错

observations.description: 成为通缉犯时，游戏不显示原因。
observations.evidence: if you become wanted, the game doesn't show you why
observations.evidence_zh: 如果你被通缉了，游戏不会告诉你原因

items.text:
I bought it when it was in like 0.1.2.1 or something like this. Back then it was buggy as hell. It felt like a pulp of features mixed together with no solid project in mind. But I wanted to like it, so I decided to wait for the full release, with way less bugs, more content and especially a better tutorial which shows exactly how this game works. 

I was happy at first when 1.0.0 was annouced, but I quickly noticed that almost nothing changed in terms of my complains. This game is a mess. And my biggest complain is that it feels like the author has ADHD and randomly created a very detailed feature, without explaining it anyhow. For example, something that simple as talking to NPC, I have no idea what's going on there, and the game doesn't explain it either.

I can easily tell that this game is unreasonably deep in some mechanics (like a talking to the NPC mentioned earlier) and at the same time straight up shallow in some other places.

In my opinion the tutorial should be a few hours long, like a campaign that guides you through every mechanics this game has to offer. Not just a basics of scavening, even if that's the main core of the gameplay.

I can't recommend it at it's current state, IT STILL FEELS LIKE AN ALPHA VERSION.
But I put huge hopes in this project and will try it again some time later. I hope my review will change next time.
items.text_zh:
我是在它还是0.1.2.1之类的版本时买的。那时候它bug多得像地狱。感觉就像一堆功能被胡乱拼凑在一起，背后没有一个扎实的项目规划。但我很想喜欢它，所以我决定等正式版发布，那时bug会少得多，内容更多，尤其是会有一个更好的教程，能确切地展示这游戏是怎么运作的。

1.0.0公布时我一开始很高兴，但我很快注意到，就我抱怨的那些问题而言，几乎什么都没变。这游戏一团糟。而我最大的抱怨是，感觉作者有ADHD，会随机地做出一个非常细致的功能，却完全不加任何解释。比如说，像和NPC对话这么简单的事，我完全不知道那里在发生什么，游戏也不解释。

我很容易就能看出，这游戏在某些机制上深得毫无道理（比如前面提到的和NPC对话），同时在其他一些地方又直白地浅薄。

在我看来，教程应该长达几个小时，像一场战役一样，引导你了解这游戏提供的每一个机制。而不只是拾荒的基础知识，哪怕那才是玩法的核心。

以它目前的状态，我无法推荐它，它仍然感觉像是一个ALPHA版本。
但我对这个项目寄予厚望，过段时间会再试一次。希望下次我的评价能有所改变。

items.text:
I have a love-hate relationship with this game, I like the direction, freedom to do stupid ♥♥♥♥ and suffer the consequences. Firing up my nuclear reactor cobbled up from space trash gave me tremendous amount of joy.

At the same time it desperately needs a quality of life pass, tackling the issues of terrible hauling in a game mostly about hauling, stutters, almost complete lack of feedback when for example my little dude is dying due to a heatstroke. More control over the automatic pause/unpause system would be nice, because it never seems to do what i want it to.

Still I'll probably do 90 more hours lol
items.text_zh:
我对这款游戏又爱又恨，我喜欢它的方向，有做蠢♥♥♥♥事并承受后果的自由。启动我用太空垃圾拼凑起来的核反应堆给我带来了巨大的快乐。

与此同时，它迫切需要一次生活质量改进，解决在一个主要关于运输的游戏中糟糕的运输问题、卡顿、几乎完全没有反馈，比如我的小家伙因为中暑而濒死时。对自动暂停/取消暂停系统有更多控制会很好，因为它似乎从来不做我想让它做的事。

不过我可能还是会再玩90个小时，哈哈

items.text:
[h1]6/10 - отличная основа, но контента быстро перестаёт хватать[/h1]

[b]64 часа после релиза 1.0.[/b]

[h2]Плюсы[/h2]

[b]+[/b] Очень интересное начало: постепенно разбираешься в корабле, атмосфере, энергии и вообще понимаешь, как тут выживать.

[b]+[/b] Классная система управления кораблём через консоль и навигацию. Полёты реально ощущаются как полёты.

[b]+[/b] Разбирать дереликты — одно из самых интересных занятий в игре.

[h2]Минусы[/h2]

[b]Однообразие.[/b] Улетел на другой конец Солнечной системы — а там практически та же игра. Те же предметы, корабли, технологии и занятия. Нового прогресса почти нет.

[b]− Интерфейс.[/b] Очень часто приходится догадываться, что делает та или иная кнопка. Например, я купил корабль через [b]Брокера[/b], а после покупки обнаружил, что он находится [b]в 276 млн км от меня[/b]. До покупки игра практически не объяснила, что я приобретаю корабль, который физически находится фиг знает где.

[b]− Баги.[/b] Особенно задолбала самопроизвольная пауза на K-Leg: уведомления отключены, автопауза отключена, но игра всё равно периодически ставит игру на паузу сама. Трам на Китайской станции вообще не работает.

[b]− Подработки и NPC быстро становятся скучными.[/b] Большинство заданий — «принеси X» или «поговори за меня». Очень не хватает нормальных цепочек заданий и событий.

[b]− Сюжетные крючки не всегда имеют отдачу.[/b] Например, я сам поставил себе целью найти родителей персонажа и ради этого полетел через станции. В итоге добрался до мамы — и практически ничего интересного не произошло.

[h2]Итог[/h2]

[b]6/10.[/b]

Атмосфера и основа игры отличные, первые десятки часов реально затягивают. Но потом понимаешь, что [b]огромный мир пока наполнен слишком однообразным контентом[/b].

Потенциал у игры огромный, через годик может моддеры и разрабы игру допилят. Игру рекомендую сейчас, пока цена адекватная. Свои 50 часов вы получите кайфа а потом вам надоест.
items.text_zh:
[h1]6/10 - 出色的基础，但内容很快就变得不够用[/h1]

[b]1.0发布后64小时。[/b]

[h2]优点[/h2]

[b]+[/b] 非常有趣的开局：你会逐渐搞懂飞船、大气、能量，并总体上明白如何在这里生存。

[b]+[/b] 通过控制台和导航来操控飞船的系统很棒。飞行真的感觉像在飞行。

[b]+[/b] 拆解废弃飞船是游戏里最有趣的活动之一。

[h2]缺点[/h2]

[b]单调。[/b] 飞到太阳系的另一端——那里几乎是同样的游戏。同样的物品、飞船、科技和活动。几乎没有新的进展。

[b]− 界面。[/b] 经常得靠猜某个按钮是干什么的。比如，我通过[b]经纪人[/b]买了一艘飞船，买完之后才发现它[b]离我有2.76亿公里[/b]。购买之前，游戏几乎没有解释我买的是一艘物理上位于鬼知道哪里的飞船。

[b]− Bug。[/b] 尤其烦人的是K-Leg上的自动暂停：通知关了，自动暂停也关了，但游戏还是会时不时自己把游戏暂停。中国空间站上的电车根本不工作。

[b]− 兼职和NPC很快就变得无聊。[/b] 大多数任务都是“把X带来”或“替我说话”。非常缺少像样的任务链和事件。

[b]− 剧情钩子并不总是有回报。[/b] 比如，我自己把找到角色父母设为目标，为此穿过一个个空间站。结果找到了妈妈——却几乎没发生什么有趣的事。

[h2]总结[/h2]

[b]6/10。[/b]

氛围和游戏基础都很出色，最初几十小时确实很吸引人。但之后你会明白，[b]这个庞大的世界目前填充的内容还是太单调了[/b]。

这游戏的潜力巨大，也许一年后模组作者和开发者会把它打磨好。现在价格还算合理，我推荐这款游戏。你能获得大约50小时的乐趣，然后就会腻了。

items.text:
Edit: added parts about social and modding.

Full of bugs, poor design around every corner, and questionable balance. Also very unique, with absolutely no alternative.

Would I play it more? Absolutely. Would I enjoy it? Probably not. That's the nature of a toxic relationship.

Now, a little bit more in depth:

[h1]Bugs.[/h1]

There are a lot. Honestly, at some point I'm not entirely sure what is a bug and what is bad design. FPS drops, script errors, physics, memory leaks, everything would be broken at some point. I liked it a lot one time when the game created all files for a save, but didn't put them into a zip archive and couldn't read this save file. Easy fix, though.

[h1]Poor design[/h1]

Well, the list would be as long as the game features. Basically, everything that you would do in this game would be made in the most stupid, time-consuming, unfun way. I'm pretty sure that AI slop would make a better design. Here is a little list of examples:

When you load the game, the splash screen with update info is right before loading. I think it doesn't block the loading itself, it's just its placement is very inconvenient.

* UI is just plain bad. All of it. Like, when you're in a helmet, it blocks your UI. Because of this, I missed a very important button for 30 hours. All bags are just a fit of tedious micromanagement. Character traits are just a long list of perks without much formatting. Visor in damage mode doesn't let you see building marks, and it's VERY NEEDED to see them in that mode. When you dock, "Match speed" and "Prox Warn" alarms are not in the dock screen, AND YOU REALLY NEED THEM IN THE DOCK SCREEN.

* Quests are just 98% plain text, without barely any choices, no scene art, not even book formatting.
AI. It's very long to describe how poor the AI in this game is, it's easy to find info on all problems with it. Let's just say they often choose death instead of being part of this game. But without jokes, many people decide to play without crew at all and not deal with AI. I guess that says a lot.

* Close-quarters combat is rudimentary. Well, it's just not fun at its core and stupid. Why the hell do people with lethal wounds in vacuum die after like 5 minutes?

* Ship building. It mostly works. But there is absolutely no dry dock in the game, so you need to do it in vacuum, and that means you need to deal with AI and micromanage them, because they can randomly stop changing batteries or O2 tanks and just die. It's also a HUGE TIME SINK. At least 15 of my playtime hours were spent waiting for things to be done.

[h1]Loot[/h1]

It's sad to say, but you will see 80-90% of loot in the first 4 hours in the starter playground. There is just barely any WOW effect, not many things to be discovered. No gold mine to strike. It's just a tedious, steady grind. This problem is tied to general economy balance. In a game about making coin by salvage and exploration, this was a HUGE LETDOWN.

[H1]Social combat/NPC dialogues [/H1]

You know, I like it on paper. I think I even grasp what you need to do for results. But there is no real explanation of the system in the game or on the internet. But in reality, it's a mesh of bad UI and poor action feedback to the player. First, why do you need to look at 3-4 different parts of the screen to see the outcome of your actions after every click? Second, why do stats jump like mad when you click on an option with a simple outcome? NPCs 80% of the time answer gibberish because they play the same system, and you also say a lot of gibberish. There's really good gameplay here, but it's buried under layers of undercooked implementations.


[h1]Balance[/h1]

Well, it's shaky at best. Economy is weird and very artificial. As I said, it's a problem tied to loot. Without interesting, varied loot, it's hard to balance the economy. So they made GIGS. So you don't need to look for 10-20k ships, you can take a gig that will pay you 30k for a VERY easy task at the ship, and you can also loot this ship. But gig payments crumble under their own weight, because they're balanced around distance. So you have delivery gigs that pay you 1500, and the same delivery gigs that pay you 10mil. So, why would I salvage anything in this game about salvaging things, when I can just travel from A to B and make 2000% more profit?

Little bit about combat balance. Imagine, you're a skilled space suit user. You're in vacuum. You have a crowbar. You feel brave and on top of your game. You have no combat experience. And your enemy is a poor space suit user. He has insomnia and is on the edge of a breakdown. He's terrified. He has a pocket knife. He's 1 level higher than you in combat. Who would win? Of course, the enemy. He will absolutely destroy you with his bare hands; he wouldn't even use the pocket knife. I guess that's fair.

[h1]Mods[/h1]
Modding community is strong for a generally low playerbase. But they mostly fix annoying and bad design and UI, but they can't fix everything. This is a job for the developer. There really shouldn't be a mod that mutes the proximity alarm when you're docked, or a mod that adds EVA suit lockers, or a mod that lets AI grab multiple items before starting to work with said items. This all should be part of the base game like yesterday.

--------

So no, I can't recommend this game to anyone. Developers shouldn't release games in such a poor state out of desperation. But yes, I would probably play it more, because this is a way of a toxic relationship.
items.text_zh:
编辑：添加了关于社交和模组的部分。

到处都是bug，每个角落的设计都很糟糕，平衡性也值得怀疑。同时它又非常独特，完全没有替代品。

我会玩得更多吗？绝对会。我会享受它吗？大概不会。这就是有毒关系的本质。

现在，再深入一点：

[h1]Bug。[/h1]

有很多。老实说，到了某个时候，我都不完全确定什么是bug，什么是糟糕的设计。帧率下降、脚本错误、物理、内存泄漏，一切都会在某个时候出问题。有一次我特别喜欢的是，游戏为一个存档创建了所有文件，但没有把它们放进zip压缩包，然后无法读取这个存档文件。不过修复很简单。

[h1]糟糕的设计[/h1]

嗯，这个清单会和游戏功能一样长。基本上，你在这个游戏里做的每件事都会以最愚蠢、最耗时、最不好玩的方式来完成。我很确定AI生成的垃圾都能做出更好的设计。这里有一个小例子清单：

当你加载游戏时，带有更新信息的启动画面就在加载之前。我觉得它不会阻止加载本身，只是它的位置非常不方便。

* UI就是纯粹的糟糕。全部都是。比如，当你戴着头盔时，它会挡住你的UI。因为这个，我错过了30个小时里一个非常重要的按钮。所有背包都只是一堆繁琐的微观管理。角色特质只是一长串没有多少格式的perk。伤害模式下的面罩不让你看到建筑标记，而在那个模式下看到它们是非常必要的。当你停靠时，“匹配速度”和“接近警告”警报不在停靠界面里，而你在停靠界面里真的非常需要它们。

* 任务98%都是纯文本，几乎没有选择，没有场景美术，甚至没有书籍排版。
AI。描述这个游戏里的AI有多糟糕需要很长时间，很容易找到关于它所有问题的信息。我们就说他们经常选择死亡，而不是成为这个游戏的一部分。但不开玩笑地说，很多人决定完全不带船员玩，不跟AI打交道。我想这说明了很多。

* 近身战斗很简陋。嗯，它的核心就是不好玩而且愚蠢。为什么在真空中受了致命伤的人会在大概5分钟后死掉？

* 飞船建造。它基本上能用。但游戏里绝对没有干船坞，所以你需要在真空中进行，这意味着你需要处理AI并微观管理他们，因为他们会随机停止更换电池或氧气罐，然后直接死掉。这也是一个巨大的时间黑洞。我至少有15个小时的游戏时间花在等待事情完成上。

[h1]战利品[/h1]

说起来很遗憾，但你会在新手游乐场的前4个小时里看到80-90%的战利品。几乎没有什么WOW效果，没有多少东西可供发现。没有金矿可挖。这只是一个乏味、稳定的刷。这个问题与总体经济平衡有关。在一个通过打捞和探索赚钱的游戏中，这是一个巨大的失望。

[H1]社交战斗/NPC对话 [/H1]

你知道，理论上我喜欢它。我想我甚至明白你需要做什么才能得到结果。但游戏里或网上都没有对这个系统的真正解释。但实际上，它是糟糕UI和对玩家行动反馈不佳的混合体。首先，为什么你每次点击后都需要看屏幕上3-4个不同的部分才能看到你行动的结果？其次，为什么当你点击一个结果简单的选项时，属性会疯狂跳动？NPC有80%的时间回答的是胡言乱语，因为他们玩的是同一个系统，你也会说很多胡言乱语。这里确实有很好的玩法，但它被层层未煮熟的实现埋没了。


[h1]平衡[/h1]

嗯，往好了说也是摇摇欲坠。经济很奇怪而且非常人为。正如我所说，这是一个与战利品相关的问题。没有有趣、多样的战利品，就很难平衡经济。所以他们做了GIGS。这样你就不需要寻找1-2万的飞船，你可以接一个GIG，在飞船上做一个非常简单的任务就能付你3万，而且你还可以打捞这艘飞船。但GIG的报酬在自身重量下崩溃了，因为它们是围绕距离来平衡的。所以你有付你1500的送货GIG，也有付你1000万的同样的送货GIG。那么，在这个关于打捞东西的游戏中，我为什么要打捞任何东西，当我可以从A旅行到B并赚取多2000%的利润时？

关于战斗平衡说一点。想象一下，你是一个熟练的太空服使用者。你在真空中。你有一根撬棍。你感到勇敢，状态极佳。你没有战斗经验。而你的敌人是一个可怜的太空服使用者。他失眠，处于崩溃边缘。他吓坏了。他有一把袖珍刀。他在战斗中比你高1级。谁会赢？当然是敌人。他会赤手空拳绝对摧毁你；他甚至不会用袖珍刀。我想这很公平。

[h1]模组[/h1]
对于一个总体玩家基数很低的游戏来说，模组社区很强大。但他们大多修复烦人和糟糕的设计与UI，但他们不能修复一切。这是开发者的工作。真的不应该有一个模组来在你停靠时静音接近警报，或者一个模组来添加EVA服储物柜，或者一个模组让AI在开始处理物品之前抓取多个物品。所有这些昨天就应该成为基础游戏的一部分。

--------

所以不，我不能向任何人推荐这个游戏。开发者不应该出于绝望而发布处于如此糟糕状态的游戏。但是的，我可能会玩得更多，因为这是一种有毒关系的方式。

items.text:
The idea of the game is great, i supported with early access a long ago and I returned to it with every major milestone, but very disappointed in 1.0
The problems are: there are too many things that do not work as intended or are just plain bugs.
The core loop, at the start at least, is
- find ship -> disassemble ship -> sell parts -> complain that you don't have money -> repeat

BUT
- the automated commands for disassemble, build and haul to hangar zones do not work well
> they are laggy
> they are buggy: you unistall a wall that had a power conduit in it? If you give the command Haul restricted to electrical things, the wall gets hauled in the elettrical zone of your hangar too. And so it's with a lot of other things
- After the first one or two ships you have to use the automation IA of the characters to do things, but it's simply crap as:
> it prioritize things in a non easy to undestarnd way, and there is no control over its priorities
> it's buggy: it get stuck doing the same things, it takes in game minutes to figure out what to do

Then also: it's a sci-fi building / exploring game and you have to manage your resources and keep track of items... but there is no way of knowing things like
> My ship consumes 70W, ok: which part is draining power, how can I manage that? i cannot know, and the simple answer is just power down thing MANUALLY when you dont need them. 
I'm building a spaceship, but i don't get basic logic circuits to manage it.

Like: i'm docket at port -> power down air systems or navigation or whatever.
The Fun would be building those systems and see them work or fail. If you give building capabilities then... you have to have them, you cant just have a middle ground.

I really hope they improve this basic mechanics as they really bug the the whole game which is good
items.text_zh:
这个游戏的点子很棒，我很久以前就在抢先体验阶段支持了它，并且每次重大里程碑更新我都会回来玩，但对1.0版本非常失望。
问题在于：有太多东西没有按预期运作，或者干脆就是纯粹的bug。
核心循环，至少一开始是
- 找到飞船 -> 拆解飞船 -> 卖掉零件 -> 抱怨自己没钱 -> 重复

但是
- 用于拆解、建造和搬运到机库区域的自动化命令运作得不好
> 它们很卡
> 它们有bug：你拆掉一面里面有电力导管的墙？如果你下达限制为电气物品的搬运命令，那面墙也会被搬运到机库的电气区域里。很多其他东西也是如此
- 在最初一两艘飞船之后，你必须使用角色的自动化AI来做事情，但它简直就是垃圾，因为：
> 它以一种不容易理解的方式排列优先级，而且无法控制它的优先级
> 它有bug：它会卡住反复做同样的事情，要花游戏内好几分钟才能弄清楚该做什么

然后还有：这是一款科幻建造/探索游戏，你必须管理资源并追踪物品……但根本没有办法知道诸如
> 我的飞船消耗70W，好吧：哪个部件在耗电，我该如何管理？我无法知道，而简单的答案就是在你不需要它们时手动关闭设备。
我正在建造一艘宇宙飞船，但我却拿不到用来管理它的基础逻辑电路。

比如：我停靠在港口 -> 关闭空气系统或导航或其他什么。
乐趣本应是建造这些系统并看着它们运作或失败。如果你给了建造能力，那么……你就必须拥有它们，你不能只搞个折中方案。

我真的希望他们改进这些基础机制，因为它们确实搞坏了整个游戏，而这游戏本身是好的

items.text:
1.0, but still incredibly buggy. Give it a bit.

Pretty decent storylines, or at-least what they're consisting of so far is pretty good. The game, even after 'full release' is basically Bethesda-coded, with bugs that range from minor annoyances to "I had to restart my 60 hour save because of this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bug." And some of the worst combat I've seen in a game like this. 

Ideas to make the game less of a misery:
-Fix the horrible bug that disables your ability to actually construct anything, despite having the tools and items to do so
-Get rid of the annoying loading splash screen (Why do we gotta' click? Just load.)
-Fix the god-awful lag/stuttering/freezing issues
-Fix the scroll-wheel's zoom rubber banding after exiting a menu.
-Fix the horrible PDA files ui
-Fix the strangely low spawn rate for Heavy Water containers.
-Make it obvious which PDA is yours in the files menu
-Make it impossible for police to warrant you when a ship's transponder is off.
-O2 tank refill auto-shutoff
-Player-placed items REMAIN the player's property. (That's my battery charger, stop arresting me because I picked it up.)
-Allow docking at stations while towing a vessel
-Make most containers on-board ships and station private property so I can't just yoink someone's weed cigs.
-Different ways of reaching other planets without having to grind for RL days to get a Torch Drive.
-More space horror
-Add the transit kiosks in a tram-like station so we aren't just teleporting to other parts of stations.
-More advancements from certain NEOScavenger plots.
- Less tedious sleep/super-fast skip mechanic
- Refined auto-task coding (No, I don't want you to stand there with an empty power drill, PUT your fully charged back-up battery in it!)
items.text_zh:
1.0，但仍然bug多得离谱。再给它点时间吧。

剧情还算不错，至少目前的内容相当可以。这游戏即使在“正式发布”之后，基本上还是贝塞斯达式的，bug从轻微烦人到“因为这个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥的bug我不得不重开我60小时的存档”都有。而且战斗是我在这种游戏里见过最糟糕的之一。

让游戏不那么痛苦的想法：
-修复那个可怕的bug，它会让你无法实际建造任何东西，尽管你有工具和物品
-去掉烦人的加载启动画面（为什么非得点一下？直接加载就行了。）
-修复那糟糕透顶的卡顿/掉帧/冻结问题
-修复退出菜单后滚轮缩放的回弹问题
-修复糟糕的PDA文件界面
-修复重水容器生成率异常低的问题
-在文件菜单里明确标出哪个PDA是你的
-让警察在飞船应答器关闭时无法通缉你
-O2罐加满后自动关闭
-玩家放置的物品保持为玩家财产。（那是我的电池充电器，别因为我把它捡起来就逮捕我。）
-允许在拖拽船只时停靠空间站
-把飞船和空间站上的大多数容器设为私有财产，这样我就不能随便顺走别人的大麻烟了
-提供不用为了弄到火炬引擎而肝现实里好几天就能到达其他星球的不同方式
-更多太空恐怖
-在有轨电车式车站里加交通亭，这样我们就不是直接传送到空间站其他部分了
-某些NEOScavenger剧情线有更多进展
-减少繁琐的睡眠/超快跳过机制
-改进自动任务编码（不，我不想让你拿着空电钻站在那里，把你充满电的备用电池装进去！）

items.text:
I wish I could recommend this. I LOVE the ideas and really enjoy playing it most of the time. But the game keeps trying to ruin the experience.

My biggest gripe: I love designing ships, but how do you make a ship editor that doesn't give you the ship diagnostics of the ship you're building? How many thrusters and fuel am i going to need to make this move and yet not knock out my character from G-forces? Who knows, I have to add up the mass of all the pieces I'm using individually (100's of pieces). The wiki doesn't have the mass. The editor doesn't show the mass. Heck, right clicking a piece in an active game doesn't show the mass. Only picking up an uninstalled piece in game shows you the mass. I have no way to know if i'm building an immovable brick or a sponge attached to a firework!

Positives: The salvaging and space navigation are really fun, the modular nav station interface is awesome, the potential is huge. It feels like space is dangerous, exciting and full of adventure.

Negatives: "Socialising" is soulless and a chore. I insult someone, they flirt, i flirt back, they say they're not interested. Your choices affect nothing. But there are negative effects if you don't do it. And of course, the ship editor is a disappointment.
items.text_zh:
我希望我能推荐这款游戏。我热爱这些创意，而且大多数时候真的很享受玩它。但游戏总是试图毁掉这种体验。

我最大的不满：我喜欢设计飞船，但你怎么能做一个飞船编辑器，却不给你正在建造的飞船的飞船诊断信息？我需要多少推进器和燃料才能让它动起来，同时又不让我的角色因G力而昏过去？谁知道呢，我得把使用的所有部件的质量一个个加起来（数百个部件）。Wiki上没有质量数据。编辑器不显示质量。见鬼，在正在进行的游戏里右键点击一个部件也不显示质量。只有在游戏里捡起一个未安装的部件才会显示质量。我根本没办法知道我是在造一块动不了的砖头，还是造一个绑在烟花上的海绵！

优点：打捞和太空航行真的很有趣，模块化的导航站界面很棒，潜力巨大。感觉太空既危险又刺激，充满冒险。

缺点：“社交”毫无灵魂，是件苦差事。我侮辱某人，他们调情，我调情回去，他们说他们不感兴趣。你的选择毫无影响。但如果你不做，就会有负面效果。当然，飞船编辑器也令人失望。

items.text:
Ostranauts is definitely not easy to recommend in its current state as of 1.0.  It's got jank and a lot of half-baked features, but the hard sci-fi elements of salvaging, building and piloting ships around the solar system is fun enough.  Traveling long distances feels equally rewarding and risky, as lack of preparation, improper planning or a piloting mistake will leave you stranded.  That said, you'll probably get a more complete experience if you wait a while for more patches to be added and mods to be developed.

Here a few things that I dislike about the current state of the game:

-NPC interactions.  I like the idea, but interacting with NPCs is just bland at the surface level once you understand the minigame.  There is hardly any unique dialogue outside of the rather few story missions.
-Speaking of missions, NPCs will randomly ask you, a seemingly complete stranger, to do a task for them that involves finding someone, talking to them (beating them up first being optional sometimes), and then traveling back.  The "someone to find" is random and sometimes on a completely different planetary body, or in my case, driving a police patrol craft in deep space 1.2 AU from Ganymede, where they should have been stationed.  Oh, and there is no reward for these, so I'm not really sure what the point is.  (The actual story missions are neat, but few and far between.)
-Lack of ship VFX.  We're under thrust using a torch drive burning at 4gs spinward, yet ships have no visible drive plumes.
-Stats of ship components are not visible anywhere.  For example, the mass and durability of walls and floors vary based on the manufacturer, but this isn't listed anywhere in-game and cannot be viewed outside of obtaining a mass scanner plugin for your PDA, which you probably won't find until you've already added on to your ship.  This applies to basically every electronic item in the game too.
-NPC crew member controls.  During scheduled work time, NPCs will often ignore orders and just do whatever the hell they want.  The only way I could get them to stop "studying" on the computer I installed in the break room was to unplug it during working hours.  Also there needs to be global orders you can quickly give that override other activities, such as "emergency repairs" and "secure for maneuvering" (to you know, get in a crash couch before they are crushed to death.)
-Lack of advanced hauling/bartering zone controls to let you specify exactly where items should be stored, and for NPCs to actually haul items to be stored there.  Currently, if I purchase scrap, it ends up in my fridge, even though the fridge is set as a "food only" zone.  The opposite happens too.  
-Physics simulation is a little too simple.  It doesn't matter where you put your thrusters or where your center of mass is, the ship behaves the same regardless.  Aerodynamics is determined entirely by mass and how many heavy lift rotors and aerodynamic hull parts you have, not necessarily the shape of the ship.  There is no explosive decompression, and atmospheric flight using heavy lift rotors needs a pass.  (Specifically, you have to have an even number of clockwise and counter-clockwise spinning heavy lift rotors, otherwise you get stuck in a death spin.  There is no way to change direction other than unpowering and repowering them.)
-Inventory is just weird.  You have a space suit, but no specially designed bag to carry stuff around in while in a space suit, so your character has to occupy a hand by dragging around a backpack permanently.
-No way to automate putting on/taking off a suit.  Until a person spends enough time in a space suit (upwards of a month from what I can tell), they suffer a severe work speed penalty.
-Lack of proper airlocks.  You're always briefly leaking atmos when crew enter/leave the ship because airlocks are effectively two doors put a few feet apart, with no way to "cycle" airlocks.
-Lack of crew retention and benefits.  Crew are paid a pathetic amount daily.  You could be bringing in millions in a trade run, but they're only getting $250.  Micromanage them too hard or don't meet one of their needs (which are somewhat obfuscated), and they'll just up and quit on you, and there is no way to give them a higher salary until they decide to quit.  A way to reward hard work (because crew do slack off)/match their pay to the skills they've developed since joining, and maybe even a healthcare plan to automate the treating those nasty blisters they got when your ship suddenly lost pressure and their skin boiled would be a really nice addition.

These are just to name a few, and thankfully, there are a few mods that can cover some half-baked features and IMO should be included in the full game:

"Ship's Water" - A mod that adds water tanks, showers, waste water storage/processing and the ability to bulk purchase water.  Otherwise, you're filling up bottles in slowly recharging sinks on stations, or tediously buying containers of it.  Crew need to drink and bathe with water with or without this mod, but this makes managing water much less tedious. This is seriously a "must have" mod.

"Uninstall and Haul" - In Vanilla, when you first dock with a wreck, you can run through and mark anything you want to salvage in-tact with an "uninstall" order.  Unfortunately, you will then have to order it to be "hauled" back to your ship after the component was uninstalled.  This mod adds a combined order that will save you a ton of time and needless tedium.
items.text_zh:
就1.0版本目前的状况而言，《Ostranauts》绝对不容易推荐。它有不少毛病和大量半生不熟的功能，但在太阳系各处打捞、建造和驾驶飞船这些硬科幻元素还是足够有趣的。长途旅行既让人感到有回报又充满风险，因为准备不足、计划不当或驾驶失误都会让你被困在途中。话虽如此，如果你等上一段时间，等更多补丁加入、模组开发出来，你可能会获得更完整的体验。

以下是我不喜欢游戏当前状态的一些地方：

-NPC互动。我喜欢这个想法，但一旦你理解了这个小游戏，与NPC互动在表面层面上就显得平淡无奇。除了相当少的故事任务之外，几乎没有任何独特的对话。
-说到任务，NPC会随机要求你——一个看似完全陌生的人——为他们做一项任务，包括找到某人、与他们交谈（有时可以先揍他们一顿，这是可选的），然后再返回。那个“要找的人”是随机的，有时在一个完全不同的行星体上，或者就我的情况而言，在距离木卫三1.2天文单位的深空中驾驶一艘警察巡逻艇，而他们本该驻扎在那里。哦，而且这些任务没有奖励，所以我真不太确定意义何在。（实际的故事任务很不错，但少而间隔很远。）
-缺乏飞船视觉特效。我们正在使用火炬驱动器以4g的加速度向旋进方向推进，但飞船却没有可见的驱动尾焰。
-飞船部件的属性在任何地方都看不到。例如，墙壁和地板的重量和耐久度因制造商而异，但这在游戏内任何地方都没有列出，除非为你的PDA获得一个质量扫描插件，否则无法查看，而你很可能在已经给飞船加建之后才会找到它。这基本上也适用于游戏中的每一件电子物品。
-NPC船员控制。在预定的工作时间，NPC经常会无视命令，想干什么就干什么。我唯一能让他们停止在我安装在休息室的电脑上“学习”的办法，就是在工作时间里拔掉电脑电源。此外还需要可以快速下达、覆盖其他活动的全局命令，比如“紧急维修”和“固定好准备机动”（你懂的，让他们在被压死之前坐进防撞座椅。）
-缺乏高级搬运/交易区域控制，无法让你精确指定物品应该存放在哪里，也无法让NPC真正把物品搬运到那里存放。目前，如果我购买废料，它最终会出现在我的冰箱里，即使冰箱被设置为“仅限食物”区域。反过来也会发生。
-物理模拟有点太简单了。你把推进器放在哪里、你的质心在哪里都无所谓，飞船的表现都一样。空气动力学完全由质量和你有多少重型升力旋翼以及空气动力学船体部件决定，而不一定是飞船的形状。没有爆炸性失压，使用重型升力旋翼的大气飞行也需要重新调整。（具体来说，你必须拥有偶数个顺时针和逆时针旋转的重型升力旋翼，否则你就会陷入死亡旋转。除了断电再重新通电之外，没有办法改变方向。）
-物品栏就是很奇怪。你有一套太空服，但没有专门设计的包可以在穿着太空服时携带东西，所以你的角色必须占用一只手，永久拖着一个背包。
只能永久拖着一个背包，占用一只手。
-无法自动穿上/脱下宇航服。在一个人在宇航服中待够足够长的时间之前（据我所知要一个月以上），他们会遭受严重的工作速度惩罚。
-缺乏真正的气闸。每当船员进出飞船时，你总是会短暂地泄漏大气，因为气闸实际上只是相隔几英尺的两扇门，无法对气闸进行“循环”。
-缺乏船员留存和福利。船员每天的报酬少得可怜。你可能在一次贸易运输中赚到数百万，但他们只拿到250美元。对他们微观管理得太狠，或者没有满足他们的某项需求（这些需求有些模糊不清），他们就会直接辞职不干，而且在他们决定辞职之前，你没有办法给他们更高的薪水。一种奖励辛勤工作（因为船员确实会偷懒）/让他们的薪酬与他们加入后发展出的技能相匹配的方式，甚至也许一个医疗计划来自动治疗当你的飞船突然失压、他们的皮肤沸腾时他们得到的那些讨厌的水泡，将会是非常棒的补充。

这些只是列举几个，幸运的是，有一些模组可以覆盖一些半成品功能，在我看来应该被纳入完整游戏中：

“Ship's Water”——一个添加水箱、淋浴、废水储存/处理以及批量购买水的能力的模组。否则，你只能在空间站上缓慢补水的洗手池里灌瓶子，或者繁琐地购买一箱箱的水。无论有没有这个模组，船员都需要用水喝水和洗澡，但这让管理水变得不那么繁琐。这绝对是一个“必备”模组。

“Uninstall and Haul”——在原版中，当你第一次与一艘残骸对接时，你可以跑过去并用“卸载”命令标记任何你想完好打捞的东西。不幸的是，在组件被卸载后，你还得再命令把它“搬运”回你的飞船。这个模组添加了一个组合命令，将为你节省大量时间和不必要的繁琐操作。

observations.description: 飞船组件属性在游戏中不可见
observations.evidence: Stats of ship components are not visible anywhere.
observations.evidence_zh: 飞船组件的属性在任何地方都看不到。

万人受けはしないが刺さる人には刺さるゲームではあるが、いかんせん不便も多い
良い所は他のレビューで見てくれたら分かるので気になった点を

Ver1.0.7で0.15.0.7向け日本語化MODを入れてプレイ

色々と説明不足なUI

例えば空調UI
エアポンプと酸素缶を設置してオートにしたら良い感じに動いてくれるだろう
→動いてくれない？？？何故？？？
→オート設定時にUIのネジをクリックしてパネル外して出て来るUIでセンサーと接続しないとオート稼働しない

自動運搬AI周りが非効率的で、自動建設指示してもあらかじめ設置するフロアやら電線を所持させておかないとわざわざ一つずつ拾ってきて設置するとかされる
そういうお馬鹿な挙動のケアを手動でする必要が出て来るから忍耐力を要求される面は確実にある

犯罪した際に無限に罰金要求されて詰みデータになったりもするのは日本語化MODが古いからなのか？
だからちゃんとライセンス購入し合法的な活動を心掛ける必要がある

それと寄港している際に一般NPCが勝手に乗船して冷蔵庫開けて食糧盗み食いしたり水飲んだりしてくる
マップ上にある物資の所有権の概念がないからか、おそらく公共の共有物として盗まれる
対策としてドアをロックすればが良いが特定の向きの問題なのか内側からロックしたいのに、外側に出てからロック処理始めるから内側からロックできないみたいなバグ挙動がある
面白い部分も多いが、そういう細かい不具合や不便も味や癖強だと許容できる人向けではある

もっと手軽に宇宙スカベンジやりたいライト層ならば『Space Haven』とかやった方が満足できると思う
明確にヘビー層向けの作品

各种说明不足的UI

比如空调UI
设置好气泵和氧气罐并调成自动，应该就能很好地运作吧

大概是因为地图上物资没有所有权概念，被当作公共共有物偷走
作为对策，锁门就好，但可能是朝向的问题，明明想从内侧上锁，却会先跑到外侧才开始上锁处理，导致无法从内侧上锁，有这种bug行为

有趣的地方也很多，但这类细小故障和不便，也属于味道和怪癖很强、能容许的人才适合

items.text:
The game concept is really interesting, but... controlling the protagonist, the UI, the ships and their interior layouts, and a few other things are a total disaster.
Probably one of the worst games I've ever played.
I get that hauling components salvaged from wrecks makes some sense... but the scale of it is so massive that, in the early game—when you can't afford big ships—it’s just absurd. And don't get me started on the licenses you have to buy just to salvage wrecks.
The ships are so poorly designed that they don't look like spaceships at all; they look like a turd in the toilet after a heavy night of partying.
All in all, the game is ridiculously overcomplicated, and the developers must be into BDSM.
Do I recommend the game? Definitely not! I wish I could get a refund—this was probably the worst money I've spent in the last decade.
items.text_zh:
游戏概念真的很有意思，但是……操控主角、UI、飞船及其内部布局，还有其他一些东西，完全是一场灾难。
大概是我玩过的最烂的游戏之一。
我明白从残骸中打捞零件来运输是有一定道理的……但规模实在太庞大了，在游戏前期——当你买不起大船的时候——简直荒谬。更别提为了打捞残骸还得买那些许可证。
飞船设计得如此糟糕，根本不像宇宙飞船；它们看起来就像狂欢一夜后马桶里的屎。
总而言之，这游戏复杂得离谱，开发者肯定喜欢BDSM。
我推荐这游戏吗？绝对不推荐！我真希望能退款——这大概是我过去十年里花得最冤的一笔钱。

observations.evidence_zh: 用户界面、飞船及其内部布局，还有其他一些东西，完全是一场灾难。

items.text: Great concept, the initial and core loop is kind of satisfying and interesting enough. It really did scratch that itch of being trapped inside a worn out spaceship controlling oxygen levels, pressure, etc but after a few runs where you have to dismantle derelict ships for parts to sell, it quickly turns into a chore. Also, everything else feels half-done, the combat UI is horrible with a barebones combat log with no proper feedback to what is actually happening. The NPC interaction mini-game is one of the most unfun systems I have ever saw in a game. I would recommend buying it only as tech demo, as the game is clearly unfinished and was pushed out the door with a 1.0 tag on it so the dev can call it quits and move on to other projects.
items.text_zh: 概念很棒，最初的核心循环还算令人满意，也足够有趣。它确实满足了我那种被困在一艘破旧飞船里、控制氧气水平、气压等等的渴望，但在几次需要拆解废弃飞船获取零件来出售的流程之后，它很快就变成了一件苦差事。而且，其他所有东西都感觉只做了一半，战斗UI很糟糕，只有一个简陋的战斗日志，对实际发生的事情没有恰当的反馈。NPC互动小游戏是我在游戏里见过的最不好玩的系统之一。我只会推荐把它当作技术演示来购买，因为这游戏明显未完成，却被贴上1.0的标签匆匆推出，好让开发者可以宣布收工，转去做其他项目。

items.text: I want to like this game, but it makes no sense. Like I'm sure there are rules according to which I'm detained, but I'm pretty sure that after the arrest police is supposed to put me in jail or make me pay fines or whatever. After the arrest police stays docked to me and goes on to goof around on socials and watch tv. No obvious path forward. Can't tell what's a bug and what's not, which is the worst kind of game. This game is not difficult, the only thing that makes it "hardcore" is complete lack of transparency and dumb design decisions.

items.text:
This is one of those really difficult reviews where I wish I could give a more nuanced rating than "yes" or "no", but I have to lean toward "no". While my hours are inflated (full hours get added up from if it was running when you enter/exit your computer's sleep mode), it's absolutely been something I'd come back to repeatedly, so if the question is "will you get ~$16  of entertainment?" the answer is very probably "Yes".

However, the game has MASSIVE flaws, and ultimately it hasn't changed much from the state it was in even like 4-5 years ago. 

I've seen a lot of reviews go into detail about issues with the AI, and while those can be real I think a lot of the discussion there is kinda missing the bigger picture:
[b]This game has no point.[/b]

Gameplay for you if you've started is gonna feel exciting! There's so many wrecks to go explore, if you have a keen eye you might notice a couple (as in just two...) nearby-ish areas worth checking out, and you'll probably find yourself in a pretty initially satisfying loop of scrapping ships for valuable components to sell and improving your own starter ship a little. 

Then you might start trying to flip ships to make some serious money sooner, or to at least be less dependent on OKLG since there's literally no sources of electrical power other than fusion reactors or buying it from a station.

Now the game will have started to feel a lot more grindy, especially as you start to realize how many systems just aren't deep at all... except maybe deeply repetitive. But alright, you're making money and maybe hired an NPC and you've been micromanaging twice as much as before because their autonomy sucks and the tools to give them specific orders suck (you can't even queue orders except in a very specific way that has no priority or order and might result in them deciding it's time to nearly smoke themselves to death in airlock instead of working). 

But hey, now you've got the cash to pay off your debt and afford fuel for the fusion reactor you've built by now! It's time to go torching across the system! And hey, there seemed to at least be one quest that had actual story to it instead of being FO4 infinite quest tier, over at The Flotilla, maybe the world's gonna finally open up now and have so much more depth!

Oh.

[i] Oh... [/i]

It's about here where, after journeying for a few days to Venus or Ceres, that feeling is going to start to creep in. You'll realize almost nothing is really different -- that every station feels exceptionally sterile and lifeless, and while there's a few tiny scattered bits of content you can try to participate in, there's somehow even less story content there to capture you than NEO Scavenger. 

Anyway, that probably does an adequate job of describing my main gripe with the game. 

Because, see, It runs well, it's truly cool how some systems can appear to have depth at first, and while there's massive issues with AI you don't really have to engage with them at all. Even with flaws like the AI, you can make some use of a crewmember by just keeping them on permanent repair duty inside the ship or just treat them as an organic sex doll + chatbot combo to keep your captain's moods up. Not that the moods really matter almost at all. 

Well, I guess even when saying it's cool, I can't avoid discussing flaws, huh! Same as I could discuss how cool the travel is... until you try docking at venus and realize the values you're provided are super wonky and there's very little in the way of orbital info provided to you, making docking a continuous-thrust sort of affair that somehow just feels deeply *wrong* speaking as a long-time player of games like KSP, COADE, Orbiter, etc.

Aaaaand then it always comes back to that sterility I mentioned. Every station feels empty and lifeless or just populated by ants, 99% of the apparent quests are totally sterile and literally lacking even distinct flavor text while the remainder aren't nearly common or deep enough and feel totally detached from all the systems you've otherwise been engaging with, and even the few legitimate additions compared to a few years ago like ship combat are just so simplistic and easy and hardly feel satisfying since they really don't feel meaningful on much of a level and tend to just make you realize that even on a systems level this is a game that might have 2 or 3 parts for something where another game might have 10 or 20+. 

Maybe some day Modders Will Fix It (tm), but I really don't think that seems likely. It's a great concept, but the execution is deeply lacking and frankly kinda lazy given the dev-time. If Dan ever reads this, I really don't wanna crush your spirits man, there's a reason I've still played the game probably something like 60-80 hours as of the time of the review, but this just feels like a game that could have been done significantly better instead of basically being released at a state that really feels like an Alpha or Beta build deeply in need of more content and depth. 




btw since some people have complained about performance, check my attached specs, my hardware absolutely isn't supercomputer tier and it runs just as well even on my thinkpad, I DO think the dev's done a pretty nice job on optimization.
items.text_zh:
这是一篇非常难写的评测，我希望能给出比“是”或“否”更细致的评分，但我不得不倾向于“否”。虽然我的游戏时长被夸大了（如果你在电脑进入/退出睡眠模式时游戏仍在运行，完整的小时数也会被累加进去），但这绝对是我会反复回来玩的东西，所以如果问题是“你能从中获得大约16美元的娱乐价值吗？”答案很可能是“能”。

然而，这款游戏有着巨大的缺陷，而且归根结底，它和四五年前的状态相比几乎没什么变化。

我看到很多评测详细讨论了AI的问题，虽然那些问题确实存在，但我认为很多相关讨论有点没抓住重点：
[b]这款游戏没有意义。[/b]

如果你刚开始玩，游戏体验会让你感到兴奋！有那么多残骸可以去探索，如果你眼尖的话，可能会注意到附近有那么几个（也就是仅仅两个……）值得一看的区域，而且你可能会发现自己陷入一个最初相当令人满足的循环：拆解飞船获取有价值的部件来出售，并稍微升级你自己的初始飞船。

然后你可能会开始尝试倒卖飞船来更快地赚大钱，或者至少减少对OKLG的依赖，因为除了聚变反应堆或从空间站购买之外， literally 没有任何电力来源。

现在游戏会开始感觉更加肝了，尤其是当你开始意识到有多少系统根本毫无深度……也许只是深度重复。但好吧，你在赚钱，也许雇了一个NPC，而且你一直在做双倍的微观管理，因为他们的自主性很糟糕，而且给他们下达具体命令的工具也很糟糕（你甚至无法排队命令，除非用一种非常特定的方式，这种方式没有优先级也没有顺序，可能导致他们决定是时候在气闸里把自己差点熏死，而不是去工作）。

但是嘿，现在你有现金来还清债务，并为你现在已经建好的聚变反应堆买得起燃料了！是时候穿越整个星系了！而且嘿，在The Flotilla那里似乎至少有一个任务有真正的剧情，而不是FO4那种无限任务级别的东西，也许世界终于要开放了，会有更多的深度！

哦。

[i] 哦…… [/i]

大约就是在这里，在前往金星或谷神星旅行了几天之后，那种感觉会开始悄悄袭来。你会意识到几乎没有什么真正不同——每个空间站都感觉异常 sterile 和毫无生气，虽然有一些零星的微小内容可以尝试参与，但那里能吸引你的剧情内容不知怎的比NEO Scavenger还要少。

总之，这大概足够描述我对这款游戏的主要不满之处了。

因为，你看，它运行良好，有些系统一开始看起来有深度，这真的很酷，而且虽然AI有巨大的问题，但你其实完全不必去碰它们。即使有AI这样的缺陷，你也可以通过让船员在飞船内永久执行维修任务来利用他们，或者干脆把他们当作有机性爱娃娃+聊天机器人的组合来保持船长的情绪。倒不是说情绪几乎完全不重要。

好吧，我想即使是在说它酷的时候，我也无法避免讨论缺陷，是吧！就像我可以讨论旅行有多酷……直到你尝试在金星对接，然后意识到提供给你的数值超级不稳定，而且几乎没有提供任何轨道信息，使得对接变成一种持续推力式的操作，作为一个长期玩KSP、COADE、Orbiter等游戏的玩家来说，这不知怎的就让人感觉深深*不对劲*。

然后一切又总是回到我提到的那种 sterile 感。每个空间站都感觉空荡荡、毫无生气，或者只是挤满了蚂蚁，99%的表面任务都完全 sterile，甚至字面上缺乏独特的风味文本，而剩下的那些又不够常见或不够有深度，感觉与你一直在互动的所有系统完全脱节，即使是相比几年前少数几个真正的添加内容，比如飞船战斗，也太过简单和容易，几乎不让人觉得满足，因为它们真的在大多数层面上感觉没什么意义，而且往往只会让你意识到，即使在系统层面上，这也是一款可能只有两三个部分的游戏，而另一款游戏可能有10个或20个以上。

也许有一天Modders Will Fix It（tm），但我真的不认为那看起来有可能。这是一个很棒的概念，但执行深度不足，坦率地说，考虑到开发时间，有点懒惰。如果Dan读到这个，我真的不想打击你的士气，老兄，我在写这篇评测时仍然玩了大概60到80个小时是有原因的，但这感觉就像是一款本可以做得明显更好的游戏，而不是基本上以一个真的感觉像是Alpha或Beta版本的状态发布，急需更多内容和深度。




顺便说一句，既然有些人抱怨性能问题，看看我附上的配置，我的硬件绝对不是超级计算机级别的，即使在我的ThinkPad上运行得也一样好，我确实认为开发者在优化方面做得相当不错。
在提供给你的轨道信息方面，对接变成了一种持续推力式的操作，作为一个长期玩KSP、COADE、Orbiter等游戏的玩家来说，这种感觉莫名地就是深深*不对劲*。

然后，一切又总是回到我提到的那种死气沉沉。每个空间站都感觉空荡荡、毫无生气，或者只是被一群蚂蚁占据着，99%的表面任务都完全死板，甚至字面上连独特的风味文本都没有，而剩下的那些又不够常见或不够深入，感觉与你本来一直在互动的所有系统完全脱节，即使是相比几年前少数几个真正的添加内容，比如舰船战斗，也太过简单、太容易，几乎感觉不到满足感，因为它们真的在大多数层面上感觉不到有意义，而且往往只会让你意识到，即使在系统层面上，这也是一个可能只有2到3个部分的东西，而另一个游戏可能会有10个或20多个。

也许有一天Modders Will Fix It (tm)，但我真的不认为那看起来可能。这是一个很棒的概念，但执行上严重不足，坦率地说，考虑到开发时间，还有点懒。如果Dan读到这个，我真的不想打击你的士气，老兄，有一个原因是我在写这篇评测时可能已经玩了大概60-80小时，但这感觉就像是一个本可以做得明显更好的游戏，而不是基本上以一个真的感觉像是Alpha或Beta版本的状态发布，急需更多内容和深度。




顺便说一句，既然有些人抱怨性能问题，看看我附上的配置，我的硬件绝对不是超级计算机级别的，即使在我的ThinkPad上运行得也一样好，我确实认为开发者在优化方面做得相当不错。

items.text:
I bought this game with some uncertainty but after buying I just got immediately sucked in and am loving every part of it. The game is a bit rough around the edges but at the price it is a total no-brainer to buy it if you are interested in the genre! I just keep going, can't stop scavenging and am looking forward to making my ship the best it can be. 

I will note that some of the rough edges I hope will be improved are:
- UI Scaling
- Smoother Ultrawide Support
- Improved space map interaction (often click it and it just drifts off to the abyss)

Otherwise I am just loving the systems and the world even just having scratched the surface feels rich and rewarding. Looking forward to sinking many hours into this!
items.text_zh:
我买这游戏时还有点犹豫，但买完之后立刻就被吸进去了，每个部分我都很喜欢。游戏确实有些粗糙，但以这个价格来说，如果你对这个类型感兴趣，那买它完全不用犹豫！我就是停不下来，一直搜刮，期待着把我的飞船打造成最好的样子。

我要指出，我希望一些粗糙之处能得到改进：
- UI缩放
- 更流畅的超宽屏支持
- 改进的太空地图交互（经常点了它就直接飘向深渊）

除此之外，我真的很喜欢这些系统和这个世界，哪怕只是刚摸到皮毛，也感觉内容丰富又有回报。期待投入很多小时进去！

items.text:
장점 : 현실적이고 레트로적인 메커니즘을 잘 구현해놓았음. 배 하나를 조종/정박하더라도 메커니즘이 다른 게임에 비해 복잡한 편이고 공부할게 있음.(해군 출신이라 이 정도의 복잡성이 있는 항행, 정박 매우 좋아함.) 속도가 크게 변할 때 가해지는 중력을 선원들이 견뎌야하는 것도 나름의 디테일이고 대책을 세워야 할 문제가 된다. 핵융합 발전기도 그냥 on/off가 아니라, 내부 진공상태/레이저 어레이/펠렛피더/냉각장치/발전장치를 다 확인하고 점화해야하고, 핵융합 발전기를 통한 발진(thrust)은 핵물질을 분사하기 때문에 거주지 근처에서는 사용할 수 없는 등 메커니즘적 디테일이 훌륭하다.

단점:
1. 플로티아라는 무법 정거장이 있음. "무법"정거장이기 때문에 거기 있는 부품 죄다 때가도 제지하는 놈이 없음. 구하기 힘든 몇몇 핵융합 부품 및 고급 센서들을 손쉽게 구할 수 있으니 참고.
2. npc가 내 범죄를 발견하고 경찰에 신고하려고 함. 그래서 npc를 때려눕히고 죽이고 싶진 않아서 항복을 권고함. npc는 항복했고 그대로 자기가 맞은 것까지 경찰에 신고함. 나는 그 신고하는 장면을 바라볼 수 밖에 없음. 게임 시스템상 항복한 npc는 공격할 수 없기 때문.
3. 플로티아로 가는데 갑자기 내 배가 북쪽에 있는 배로 들러붙었음(난 동쪽으로 이동 중이었는데, 배가 강제로 북쪽으로 속도가 변함.), 그래서 해적이 자석이라도 썼나, 하고 전투를 준비했더니 왠 원형탈모 아저씨가 인스타를 하고있음. 그래서 대화를 시도했더니 말이 통해서 내 선원으로 받아들이고 그 배의 부품을 싹다 털어먹음.(내 선원이기 때문에 날 적대하지 못함.) 혹시 그 배도 팔아먹을까 해서 그 아저씨에게 조종을 시켜봤음. 근데 내 배가 아니라서 조종이 안된데.(그럼 이 원형탈모는 지금까지 어떻게 조종했는데.) 그 아저씨는 당연히 해고.
4. 알 수 없는 화재. 특정 지점에서 계속 화재가 발생함. 그 근처 내구도는 죄다 100%였음. 불이 계속 나서 거기 전선 싹다 철거해버린 이후로 괜찮아짐.
5. 버려진 화물선을 정거장 근처로 예인했음. 예인을 하기 위해서는 도킹 중인 폐선에 예인장치(구하기 힘듦)를 연결하면됨. 근데 정거장 근처에서 나를 향해 날아오는 미친 배(이 게임이 당신에게 스릴을 주는 방법임)가 있어서 몸 비틀기로 피했음. 그리고 매치스피드로 정거장과 속도를 맞추고 예인장치를 해제했음(아직 화물선과 도킹중). 그리고 화물선의 화물들을 내 함선으로 옮기는 도중에, 뭔가가 내 배에 계속 충돌하기 시작함.(배가 갑자기 움직이면 log에 feeling minor gravity라는 메세지가 간헐적으로 뜸.) 네비게이션 맵을 봐도 근처에는 아무것도 없음. 그 순간 깨달음. 아 또 ㅈ버그구나. 예인장치 해제로 인해 (도킹 중임에도 불구하고) 화물선과 내 배가 분리된 걸로 인식하고 맞닿아 있는 것 만으로도 충돌로 인식된 것임.
5. 초반에는 벽과 바닥에 구멍이 난 배로 시작할 것임. 그 구멍을 전 주인이 임시 패치로 떄우고 고치질 않아서, 건드리기만 해도 폭삭 가라앉기 때문에, 그걸 고치기 위해 carbon fiber라는 재료가 필요함. 바닥과 벽을 고치는 재료이기 때문에 바닥과 벽을 분해하면 나옴. 그래서 상점에 가서 20달러를 주고 당당히 벽 블록을 구매함. 그리고 그 자리에서 침 흘리면서 블록 분해를 시작하니까 경비병이 다가옴. 나보고 범죄자래. '뭐래ㅋ'하고 그대로 블록 분해를 마침. 그 자리에서 사살 당함. 게임 메커니즘상 벽을 분해하는 행위는 기밀을 훼손하여 산소를 유출시키는 행위이기 떄문에 중범죄가 맞음. 근데 이건 내가 방금 산 벽 블록이라고..... 니들 건물을 부순게 아니란 말야...
6. 폐선에 npc가 산다. 도대체 어디서 산소가 나는지 모르겠는데 npc가 산다. 우주 한복판에 진공속에서 폐선을 돌아다닌다. 살려달란말도 구조해달란말도 없이, "what's up?".... 님 산소통에 산소 떨어지면 죽어요....
7. 아무튼 그런 npc를 두번째 만났다. 여전히 "what's up?" 이러길래, '응, 넌 거기서 살아' 하고 하던데로 폐선 분해를 시작함. 근데 갑자기 그 npc가 다가와서 칼빵을 놓음. 그대로 동료 선원이 쓰러지고 나도 깜짝 놀라서 2대1로 다굴해서 이김. "이 폐선은 내 배인데 니가 왜 함부로 분해하냐." 이런놈인듯.
8. 폐선을 구매하는 시스템이 있길래 저장하고 20만 달러짜리 싼놈으로 하나 구매해봄. 근데 아니나 다를까 원주민이 거주하고 있었음. 그래서 "내 배에서 나가!"라는 상호작용이 가능하길래 쫓아버리고 의기양양하고 있었음. 근데 폐선에 멀쩡한 부품 하나도 없고, 그냥 선체 밖에 없는거임. 그리고 쫓아낸 npc는 '니가 뭘 할 수 있는데ㅋㅋㅋ' 이러면서 내가 구매한 폐선에서 인스타 하고 있음... 그래서 칼빵놓고 구매하기 전으로 불러오기함.



하다보니까 정박 중에나 항행 중에 개 뜬금없이 선체가 터져나갈 때가 있는데, gpt 찾아보니까 미세운석일 가능성이 있다고 함. 실제로 게임에 구현도 되어있고. 그런데 그 미세 운석이라는걸 게임에서는 언급도 하지 않으며 가르쳐주지도 않으며 이로 인한 손상이 생겨도 관련된 아무런 언급도 없다.

플레이어 입장에선 버그로 터진건지 유령이 와서(폐선 작업하다보면 가끔 보임) 지건을 하고 간건지 알 수가 없으니, 이런건 게임 시스템이 아니라 게임의 문제점이 되는 것이다. 이 게임을 하다보면 개발자의 꿈은 커 보이나 디테일이나 완성도면에서 너무나 부족하고 배려가 없다. 현실성으로 인한 불편함은 당연하게 감수할 수 있다. 목마른 사람이 물을 먹기 위해 컵에 물을 따르고 내 입에 그 컵을 가져가는 작업이 왜 불편하겠는가. 그런데 아무런 언급도 없이 컵이 금이 가거나, 컵 속의 물이 x물이 되거나, 컵 바닥에서 입이 열리더니 내 물을 싹 빨아들이고 욕설을 시작하면 그건 플레이어가 받아들일 수 없는 "버그덩어리"로 인식이 될 뿐이다.
items.text_zh:
优点：很好地实现了现实且复古的机制。即使只是操纵/停泊一艘船，其机制也比其他游戏复杂，有很多东西需要学习。（作为海军出身，我非常喜欢这种复杂程度的航行、停泊。）当速度大幅变化时，船员们必须承受施加的重力，这也是某种细节，并且成为需要制定对策的问题。核聚变发电机也不是简单的开/关，而是必须确认内部真空状态/激光阵列/燃料丸供给器/冷却装置/发电装置并点火，通过核聚变发电机进行的推进(thrust)会喷射核物质，因此不能在居住区附近使用等，机制上的细节非常出色。

缺点：
1. 有一个叫弗洛蒂亚的法外空间站。因为是“法外”空间站，所以就算把那里的零件全都偷走，也没有人会制止。可以轻松获得一些难以获取的核聚变零件和高级传感器，供参考。
2. NPC发现我的犯罪后会想报警。所以我不想打晕或杀死NPC，就劝他投降。NPC投降了，然后连自己被打的事也照样报警了。我只能眼睁睁看着报警的场面。因为游戏系统上，投降的NPC无法被攻击。
3. 在去弗洛蒂亚的路上，我的船突然粘上了北边的一艘船（我明明在向东移动，船却被强制变向北边的速度。），所以我以为海盗用了什么磁铁，准备战斗，结果是一个圆形脱发的大叔在刷Instagram。于是我尝试对话，结果语言相通，就把他收为我的船员，并把他那艘船的零件全都扒光了。（因为是我的船员，所以无法敌对我。）我想着要不要把那艘船也卖掉，就让那大叔去驾驶看看。但他说因为不是我的船，所以驾驶不了。（那这个圆形脱发之前到底是怎么驾驶的。）那大叔当然被解雇了。
4. 不明原因的火灾。在特定地点持续发生火灾。那附近耐久度全都是100%。因为一直起火，把那里的电线全都拆掉之后就没问题了。
5. 把一艘废弃货船拖到了空间站附近。为了拖曳，需要把拖曳装置（很难获取）连接到已对接的废船上。但在空间站附近有一艘朝我飞来的疯狂船只（这就是这个游戏给你刺激的方式），我靠扭动身体躲开了。然后以匹配速度与空间站速度同步，并解除了拖曳装置（仍然与货船对接中）。然后在把货船的货物搬到我的舰船的过程中，有什么东西开始不断撞击我的船。（如果船突然移动，日志里会间歇性出现feeling minor gravity的消息。）看导航地图，附近什么都没有。那一刻我明白了。啊，又是该死的bug。由于解除拖曳装置，（尽管仍然对接中）货船和我的船被识别为分离，仅仅相互接触就被识别为碰撞。
5. 初期会从一艘墙壁和地板有洞的船开始。前主人用临时补丁糊上了那些洞却没有修好，所以只要一碰就会彻底沉没，为了修好它，需要一种叫碳纤维的材料。因为它是修复地板和墙壁的材料，所以分解地板和墙壁就能得到。于是我去了商店，付了20美元，堂堂正正地购买了墙壁方块。然后当场流着口水开始分解方块，警卫就走过来了。说我是罪犯。“说什么呢ㅋ”然后就这样分解完了方块。当场被射杀。游戏机制上，分解墙壁的行为是破坏机密并导致氧气泄漏的行为，所以确实是重罪。可这是我刚刚买的墙壁方块啊……又不是破坏了你们的建筑……
6. 废船里住着NPC。完全不知道氧气是从哪里来的，但NPC就住在那里。在宇宙正中央的真空中，在废船里走来走去。既不说救命也不说救救我，只说“what's up?”……您氧气瓶里的氧气用完了会死的啊……
7. 总之又第二次遇到了那样的NPC。还是“what's up?”，于是我想着‘嗯，你就住那儿吧’，然后像之前一样开始分解废船。但那个NPC突然走过来捅了我一刀。同伴船员就这样倒下了，我也吓了一跳，以二打一围殴赢了。“这废船是我的船，你凭什么随便分解。”大概是这种人。
8. 发现有购买废船的系统，于是保存后买了一个20万美元的便宜货。结果不出所料，有原住民居住着。于是有“从我的船上出去！”这样的互动，我就把他赶走，正得意洋洋。但那艘废船里没有一个完好的零件，就只剩个船体。而且被赶走的NPC还说着‘你能把我怎么样ㅋㅋㅋ’，在我购买的废船里刷Instagram……于是我捅了他一刀，然后读档回到购买之前。



玩着玩着，在停泊中或航行中，船体会突然莫名其妙地爆裂，查了gpt说可能是微陨石。游戏里确实也实现了。但游戏里既没有提到也没有教过什么微陨石，即使因此产生损伤，也没有任何相关提及。

从玩家的立场来看，根本不知道是因为bug爆的，还是幽灵来了（处理废船时偶尔会看到）给了致命一击后走的，这种事就不是游戏系统，而成了游戏的问题点。玩这个游戏时，能看出开发者的梦想很大，但在细节和完成度方面实在太不足，也缺乏关怀。因现实性带来的不便当然可以承受。口渴的人为了喝水，把水倒进杯子里，再把杯子拿到自己嘴边，这为什么会不方便呢。但如果没有任何说明，杯子裂了，或者杯子里的水变成了尿，或者杯子底部张开嘴把我的水全吸走然后开始骂人，那这只会被玩家认为是无法接受的“bug堆”。

observations.description: 船体突然破损但游戏未提示微陨石等可能原因
observations.evidence: 그 미세 운석이라는걸 게임에서는 언급도 하지 않으며 가르쳐주지도 않으며 이로 인한 손상이 생겨도 관련된 아무런 언급도 없다
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏里对所谓的微陨石既不提及也不教，而且因此产生损伤时也没有任何相关说明

items.text: It's really good, but not perfect. I think there could be much better 3D modeling for characters and held props and the life simulation/conversations with NPCs is very rough around the edges for this being 1.0. More often then not they'll just wander away mid conversation or simply fail to give a reply, stalling the convo until it fixes itself.  The prebaked responses get old fast, I genuinely feel like I'm just talking to the same person over and over again, no one so far really striking me as unique or memorable. Also the sprites used are pretty hard to identify visually at first, couldn't really tell what most things were at first glance without right clicking it or holding alt. All that being said, I really enjoy the concept and have had some fun so far. Just feel like it's missing a lot more depth/refinement/polish to truly immerse me in the world and characters. Hopefully this 1.0 achievement will fund the project a little further so these things can be overhauled. There's something truly great here, it just needs more time to fully get there imo.
items.text_zh: 它真的很好，但并不完美。我认为角色和手持道具的3D建模本可以好得多，而且对于1.0版本来说，与NPC的生活模拟/对话非常粗糙。很多时候他们会在对话中途直接走开，或者干脆不回复，让对话卡住，直到它自己恢复正常。预设好的回应很快就让人腻了，我真的感觉自己只是在一遍又一遍地和同一个人说话，到目前为止没有人真正让我觉得独特或难忘。另外，使用的精灵图一开始在视觉上很难辨认，第一眼不右键点击或按住Alt的话，我根本看不出大多数东西是什么。话虽如此，我真的很喜欢这个概念，到目前为止也玩得挺开心。只是觉得它缺少更多深度/打磨/润色，无法真正让我沉浸到这个世界和角色中。希望这个1.0成就能为项目再提供一些资金，让这些东西得以重做。这里确实有非常棒的东西，只是在我看来还需要更多时间才能完全达到那个水准。

observations.description: 精灵图难以辨认，需要右键或按Alt才能识别
observations.evidence: Also the sprites used are pretty hard to identify visually at first, couldn't really tell what most things were at first glance without right clicking it or holding alt.
observations.evidence_zh: 另外，所用的精灵图一开始在视觉上很难辨认，不右键点击或按住Alt的话，我第一眼真的看不出大多数东西是什么。

items.text:
In general, I like the depth and freedom of the game, but I really cant connect to it. 

Everything feels awfully "disconnected" from the player, its like fighting the UI/UX as everything is a bit complicated. I often struggled to remember where and how I can find general information about what is happening right now or getting a good overview of all my ressources.

Also interacting managing the inventory takes an awfull amount of time.

This game is a typical "I´ve to google stuff to really enjoy it", and even though I wanted to like this game, I cant reccomend it.
items.text_zh:
总的来说，我喜欢游戏的深度和自由度，但我真的无法投入进去。

一切都感觉与玩家极其“脱节”，就像在跟UI/UX作斗争，因为一切都有些复杂。我常常很难记住在哪里以及如何找到关于当前发生情况的通用信息，或者获得我所有资源的良好概览。

而且管理物品栏的交互也耗费大量时间。

这款游戏是典型的“我必须去谷歌查东西才能真正享受它”，尽管我想喜欢这款游戏，但我不能推荐它。

observations.description: 难以找到当前状态信息，也难以总览所有资源
observations.evidence: I often struggled to remember where and how I can find general information about what is happening right now or getting a good overview of all my ressources.
observations.evidence_zh: 我常常很难记住在哪里以及如何找到关于当前正在发生什么的通用信息，或者如何很好地总览我的所有资源。

items.text:
I really loved the atmosphere, but the navigation system definitely needs improvement. I spent almost 3 hours trying to find one specific ship to deliver an item. I kept running out of fuel or going to the wrong location. It was really hard to find where I was supposed to go because the game only tells you how far away the target is, not its exact location. I ended up checking every point of interest within the distance it showed me.

When I finally found the ship, it wouldn't give me permission to dock, and I had no idea how to let them know I was there to deliver the equipment for the job they were doing. In the end, I just forced the docking, went inside the ship, and delivered the item myself.

Then I had to fly all the way back to the station with only 20% fuel left. I was stressed the whole way because I thought I might run out of fuel before I made it back. Fortunately, I made it and got my payment.

Overall, I really enjoyed the atmosphere and the RPG elements, but I'm giving this a thumbs down because the navigation system definitely needs improvement. I CAN'T LOCATE WHERE I'M SUPPOSED TO GO!
items.text_zh:
我真的很喜欢那种氛围，但导航系统绝对需要改进。我花了将近3个小时试图找到一艘特定的飞船来运送物品。我不断耗尽燃料或者去错地方。真的很难找到我该去哪里，因为游戏只告诉你目标有多远，而不是它的确切位置。最后我只好检查了它显示的距离内每一个兴趣点。

当我终于找到那艘飞船时，它不给我停靠许可，我也不知道该怎么让他们知道我是来为他们正在做的工作运送设备的。最后，我强行停靠，进入飞船，自己把物品送了过去。

然后我不得不在只剩20%燃料的情况下飞回空间站。一路上我都很紧张，因为我以为可能在回去之前就耗尽燃料。幸运的是，我成功返回并拿到了报酬。

总的来说，我非常喜欢那种氛围和RPG元素，但我给差评，因为导航系统绝对需要改进。我找不到我该去的地方！

observations.description: 导航系统只显示距离，不显示目标具体位置，导致难以找到目标
observations.evidence: the game only tells you how far away the target is, not its exact location
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏只告诉你目标有多远，而不是它的确切位置

items.text: Tutorial is awful. Everything is so cluttered and all over the place. I couldn't recommend this game unless you enjoy game breaking bugs with wasted time invested. Maybe the 1.0 will address this, but right now I couldn't recommend it.
items.text_zh: 教程很糟糕。一切都那么杂乱，到处都是。除非你喜欢破坏游戏的bug和白白投入的时间，否则我无法推荐这款游戏。也许1.0版本会解决这个问题，但现在我无法推荐它。

observations.description: 教程界面杂乱无章，信息混乱
observations.evidence: Tutorial is awful. Everything is so cluttered and all over the place.
observations.evidence_zh: 教程糟透了。一切都杂乱无章、乱七八糟。

items.text:
[h1]1000 Hours: Just getting started.[/h1]
TLDR; if you like slow, vibey, salvage and survival. And you can be patient for the first ten hours. You'll like this a lot.

I have been playing this game for over 1000 hours. I love it. The entertainment value of 400 movies.
I like to just veg out and salvage wrecks while I watch YouTube. I've done a few of the storylines. 
The main loop is satisfying enough for me. I've done several characters, learned how to survive well enough that I am not in immediate danger. But mostly I pay off my debt, get a nice ship and start visiting the rest of the solar system.

[h2]Pros[/h2]
[list]
[*] Atmosphere - love the setting and lore, even if I don't remember all of it or need to.
[*] Buy a ship or build your own, and build it however you want
[*] This is slow space. No instant gratification. Adds to the feel
[*] Lots of ways to play - mostly I focus on stripping every wreck for the $$$ parts
[*] Devs are very responsive - several things I've reported or experienced have been fixed within a month
[*] Vibes, everything feels lived in, real.
[/list]

[h2]Cons[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bugs: there are frequently minor bugs, but they [i]mostly[/i] don't crash or block gameplay anymore.
[*] [strike]Lag: the game used to slow down a LOT[/strike] the updates from the last few months have mostly fixed this.
[*] Quests: These need some work. It's unclear what to do to progress them sometimes without looking up the wiki or discord.
[*] Employees: Hiring people is often more trouble than it is worth. They ignore your orders and try to walk outside without a helmet.
[*] AI pathing can be psychotic.
[*] Moodlets and social combat? Never clear what to do and why my chars' mood is so poor. Everyone is too horny.
[/list]

This is not an easy game. But after the first ten hours you should be able to survive long enough to not die accidentally. Take it easy when you are travelling. Speed up the game instead of speeding up your ship.
If you feel inclined, reporting detailed bug reports helps and will usually be addressed.

If you want quick combat and crazy action, this really is not for you.
items.text_zh:
[h1]1000小时：才刚刚开始。[/h1]
长话短说；如果你喜欢缓慢、有氛围的回收与生存。而且你能在最初十个小时里保持耐心。你会非常喜欢这个。

我已经玩这款游戏超过1000小时了。我爱它。娱乐价值相当于400部电影。
我喜欢一边看YouTube一边放空自己打捞残骸。我做过几条故事线。
主循环对我来说已经足够令人满足。我玩过好几个角色，学会了如何活得足够好，以至于不会立刻陷入危险。但大多数时候我还清债务，弄到一艘好船，然后开始造访太阳系的其余部分。

[h2]优点[/h2]
[list]
[*] 氛围——喜欢这个设定和背景故事，即使我记不住全部，也不需要记住。
[*] 买一艘船或自己造一艘，想怎么造就怎么造
[*] 这是缓慢的太空。没有即时满足感。这增添了感觉
[*] 有很多玩法——我主要专注于把每一艘残骸拆光，拿走值$$$的部件
[*] 开发者非常积极回应——我报告或遇到的几件事都在一个月内被修复了
[*] 氛围感，一切都感觉有人生活过，真实。
[/list]

[h2]缺点[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bug：经常有轻微bug，但它们[i]大多[/i]不再崩溃或阻碍游玩了。
[*] [strike]卡顿：游戏过去会严重变慢[/strike] 过去几个月的更新大多修复了这个问题。
[*] 任务：这些需要一些改进。有时不清楚该做什么来推进它们，除非去查wiki或discord。
[*] 雇员：雇人往往弊大于利。他们无视你的命令，还想不戴头盔走到外面去。
[*] AI寻路可能会疯得离谱。
[*] 心情状态和社交战斗？从来不清楚该做什么，也不清楚为什么我角色的心情这么差。每个人都太饥渴了。
[/list]

这不是一款简单的游戏。但在最初十个小时之后，你应该能活得足够久，不至于意外死亡。旅行时放轻松。加速游戏，而不是加速你的飞船。
如果你愿意，提交详细的bug报告会有帮助，而且通常会被处理。

如果你想要快速战斗和疯狂动作，这真的不适合你。

observations.description: 情绪与社交战斗机制不清晰，角色情绪差的原因不明
observations.evidence: Moodlets and social combat? Never clear what to do and why my chars' mood is so poor.
observations.evidence_zh: 心情值和社交战斗？从来都搞不清该做什么，也搞不清为什么我角色的心情这么差。

items.text:
Fun game so far, intro was somewhat confusing and makes me wish there might be a more streamlined character creation method than gambling with RNG vs time management. There's a very distinct delight when you pull off your first good salvage haul and the game feels pretty fun to play, if not clunky somewhat.

Error messages for when you lack things to complete work (like repair a wall or item) could definitely be more verbose for what you need, or what's wrong.
items.text_zh:
到目前为止游戏很有趣，开场有点令人困惑，让我希望可能会有一种比用RNG与时间管理赌博更精简的角色创建方法。当你完成第一次成功的打捞收获时，会有一种非常独特的喜悦，游戏玩起来相当有趣，尽管有些笨拙。

当你缺少完成工作所需的东西时（比如修理墙壁或物品）的错误信息，绝对可以更详细地说明你需要什么，或者哪里出了问题。

items.text:
This game is something special. Its thick with atmosphere, its janky, its original, its super fun at times and infuriatingly frustrating at others. But above all, it is not a product. Its an actual work of art that pursues its vision before accessibility or handholding. That can be frustrating at times. But first and foremost its very refreshing and inspiring when the gaming market is currently ripe with a sea of lowest common denominator games that do not dare to deviate from establshed game loop formulas or UX conventions.

In terms of look & feel, the game draws heavy inspiraton from 80s and early 90s retrofuturistic sci-fi movies like Blade Runner, Total Recall or Alien(s). Interplanetary megacorps, tube monitors, lived in and dirty spaceships, chain smoking spacers in jumpsuits - its all there. Despite the rather unimpressive graphical presentation, this game oozes style in every moment. The soundtrack, the setting and the art style work hand in hand to really immerse you into it. It does, indeed, make you nostalgic for a past you might never have experienced. 

When operating your spaceship or equipment like reactors, the game switches to a first person view of analogue control boards. You have to do everything yourself - turning knobs, flicking switches. Forgetting to turn on the proximity warning system might get you killed in a burning blaze of glory when a fuel tug on collision course slams into you while you are taking a dump on the shipboard toilet. Ran out of RCS fuel mid-flight? You manually have to walk over to the intake, unscrew the empty fuel can and replace it with a full one. Things can feel overwhelming at first, but you'll soon realize that playing the game is not nearly as complicated as the first impression might suggest. All the knob turning and switch flicking is just an extra layer of player interaction laid over quite easy to understand systems you'll get the hang of quickly if you don't let them intimidate you.

What remains after that is a visceral and very immersive feeling of actually flying and operating your own spaceship. You'll eventually know what all the different warning beeps mean and you're going to feel like a true spaceship captain when hearing and correctly identifiying the lock on warning sensor just before getting blasted to smithereens by a pirate ship.

By now, you probably noticed I'm quite fond of the game. Is it for everyone? Probably not. If you have little tolerance for bugs, jankiness and unfinished features, you will probably have a bad time. If you do not like to spend time understanding game mechanics that are, at times, not explained very well, you will probably not enjoy Ostranauts. As I mentioned, the game is still very rough around the edges. But: If you like games with deep and original systems,  you will probably love it. There is just nothing like it on the market right now. Its the closest to an actual space life sim we ever came. I say: give it a go!
items.text_zh:
这款游戏很特别。它充满氛围，它粗糙，它原创，它有时超级有趣，有时又令人恼火地沮丧。但最重要的是，它不是一件产品。它是一件真正的艺术品，追求自己的愿景，而不是可访问性或手把手指导。这有时会令人沮丧。但首先，当游戏市场目前充斥着大量最低共同标准的游戏，不敢偏离既定的游戏循环公式或用户体验惯例时，它非常令人耳目一新且鼓舞人心。

在外观和感觉方面，游戏从80年代和90年代初的复古未来主义科幻电影中汲取了大量灵感，如《银翼杀手》、《全面回忆》或《异形》。星际巨型企业、显像管显示器、有人居住且肮脏的宇宙飞船、穿着连体服不停抽烟的太空人——一切都在那里。尽管图形表现相当不起眼，但这款游戏每一刻都散发着风格。配乐、设定和艺术风格携手合作，真正让你沉浸其中。它确实让你怀念一个你可能从未经历过的过去。

在操作你的宇宙飞船或反应堆等设备时，游戏会切换到模拟控制板的第一人称视角。你必须自己做所有事情——转动旋钮、拨动开关。忘记打开接近警告系统可能会让你在一场燃烧的荣耀之火中丧命，当一艘燃料拖船在碰撞航线上撞向你时，你正在飞船厕所里拉屎。飞行途中RCS燃料用完了？你必须手动走到进气口，拧下空燃料罐，换上一个满的。一开始可能会感到不知所措，但你很快会意识到，玩这个游戏并不像第一印象所暗示的那么复杂。所有转动旋钮和拨动开关只是玩家互动的一层额外层次，覆盖在相当容易理解的系统之上，如果你不让它们吓到你，你很快就会掌握。

剩下的是一种发自内心且非常沉浸的感觉，仿佛你真的在飞行和操作自己的宇宙飞船。你最终会知道所有不同的警告哔哔声意味着什么，当你听到并正确识别锁定警告传感器，就在被海盗船炸成碎片之前，你会感觉自己像一个真正的宇宙飞船船长。

到现在，你可能注意到我非常喜欢这个游戏。它适合所有人吗？可能不是。如果你对bug、粗糙和未完成的功能容忍度很低，你可能会玩得很糟糕。如果你不喜欢花时间理解有时解释得不太好的游戏机制，你可能不会喜欢Ostranauts。正如我提到的，这个游戏仍然非常粗糙。但是：如果你喜欢具有深度和原创系统的游戏，你可能会爱上它。目前市场上没有类似的东西。这是我们最接近真正的太空生活模拟的一次。我说：试一试吧！

I haven't played much, but I already know this one is a BANGER.

If you like extraction-type, make money, spaceship simulators this is your game. The UI is kinda difficult to read through at first, although that might just be my ADHD. The interactivity with piloting your ship is one of the most creative little gimmicks I've seen in gaming. I hope they keep adding more to this game, because this could be like the next big one.

Can't wait to get into it, my only reason I haven't no lifed it so far is because my C drive is failing and I can't save the game so I gotta wait till I can afford a new SSD!

items.text:
硬核回收废船捡垃圾游戏

沉浸感做的很不错，
那种喜欢那种冷战电子风操作站，
热衷于转旋钮，扳电门的，通过读仪表间接判断飞船态势的复古爱好者，
开飞船时一定会很有感觉
但反之则会感觉很无聊，而且我相信觉得无聊的人一定会占大多数

而且作为《末日拾荒者》某种意义上的续作。
星际拾荒者有继承了他底特律兄弟相同的缺点就是[b]不必要[/b]的游戏难度
这个游戏的时长完全建立在游戏陡峭的学习曲线上
(舱压，气体成分比例，温度传导，较为硬核的飞船驾驶等)
换句话说这游戏主要的内容在于 [b]学会玩这个游戏[/b]
但是等妳真花大量时间摸清楚每一个游戏机制之后又会发现，
这游戏其实并没有提供利用这些机制继续创造兴趣的地方
这个游戏里所有的难点唯一存在的意义就是给你的游戏新手期添堵
但熟悉流程之后只要跟着安全手册，按部就班的做了该做的，生存下去甚至赚大钱其实简单的有些无聊

熟练的妳可以在开局第一天还完欠款，然后。。。就没了
这个游戏里妳不作死就真的不会死，而且游戏目前还没有什么让玩家主动作死的理由
就像我说的，妳可以在第一天财富自由，
然后一下失去继续玩下去的动力。
当然你可以给自己订目标，比如买大房造大船。
但是失去还款的紧迫感，玩家也就不需要冒险去干高风险高收益的活。
这是一个游戏内时间流动速度和现实一样的游戏(当然允许玩家自行加速)，
选择玩这个游戏的人大多有的是时间去杀，
在这个前提下很难想象有人会为了短时间多赚点钱去铤而走险
不，我甚至想不出该怎样冒险才能有更高收益，
反正废船模板就那几样，跑一趟赚多少全凭孕气，玩家的主观选择产生不了太大影响

公式化的离港，公式化的航行，公式化的对接，
公式化的打一场操作体验很糟糕但是几乎必胜的战斗，
公式化的拆高价值物品，公式化的返航，
公式化的的把战利品按一成不变的价格卖给奸商。

另外这个游戏不但没有什么“甜区”把玩家黏住，反而是各种没必要的微操消磨玩家兴致
举例，我从新手村出发去金星，路程两天。
期间就是吃饭->拉屎->看p站手冲一发->睡觉->跳过睡眠时间。重复循环。
每一项动作都要在三级以上的菜单里，排的密密麻麻的选项中点来点去，
这期间甚至不会出什么意外，就是平平无奇的一趟旅程，可就是要一遍又一遍重复这种无意义的操作。

简而言之，这个游戏还需要太多能增加游戏趣味的随机事件或后期目标
就目前看来他还只是个平淡的废船回收员模拟器。
他确实有着独特的游戏机制，但又没有给玩家发挥这些机制的空间

或许在等个几年在回来看看吧
