items.text:
Whilst this game could allow for a lot replayability it has problems.

It lacks basic features that would improve the game a lot, it is needlessly complicated in some areas and front loaded. Yet somehow shallow. It lacks info about what anything does, like player traits.

Here is some simple things, what I think it needs as a priority:
Unable to quit to main menu from character creation, in case you pressed wrong button or wanna try again. 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'.
For some reason container items need to be interacting with and you need to select 'inventory'. Look I love inventory management, heck I love CDDA, but requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good. I cannot stress the amount this reduced my enjoyment. Having to check everythings inventory is tedious.
Unable to label or change name of items, that glass bottle of 'vodka' you have for coffee? Yeah your gonna have to use the previous inventory checking each time you want to go through your stuff, as you can't tell at a glance what's in it?
Using control to pick up single items from a stack is impossible, you use control to instead 'place' one from the stack? Seems backwards.
Kicks you out of nav panel on ships when closing the ship menu, very annoying when you are learning the game and after still annoying.
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying, Trying to figure out your heading AND viewing your target is very difficult. This COULD be forgiven if better navigation parts are added later, but I seriously doubt such poor UI would be on every ship in galaxy. You can't even get predictions on where an object is travel that you have targeted, or even the angle between you and the target.

Other areas to improve:
The OST is not very good, it could use better music. I turned it off after a bit. The first one is good for the character creation though.
Traits that do nothing.
Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
All ships have the same UI?
Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
No 'buffer' for new characters from fees, means 100% your first character you spent time on will be a waste, should be able to 'pre' save already built characters with same parents, etc.
Changing your last name does not affect your origins.
All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers. Why assign parents at all? They don't appear to affect your story in the slightest? Character creation options are limited, n general the options for females in particular are bad, I tried playing a few times and once it gave me a female character, after wasting time making a character I realised that it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body. But across the board it is lacking, you can't even make a character that looks like the loading screens... or even 'normal' looking.
The loan system for your ship seems a bit weird? You can loan for a $800,000 ship, but can't for a $80,000 + some extra like gear? Or a license? I dunno man. Stuff doesn't make sense, in the description of one ship it mentions you worked on it... why can't you work on the cheapest ship?
The LONG saving times, are an issue.
The character creation is sometimes annoying, 'seek ship' should not show the same ship more then once, even if it adds more time the next time you look.
NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside? Even from port?


I tried to enjoy this game as it seems to have all the elements for a game I would enjoy but it is half baked at least for now and I just don't. It ain't even that deep either, even though it seems complicated up front, once you play a little bit it is a really simple game.

Still all that said I still think this will be a good game after some updates, unfortunately from what I can see that would take at least 3 years at current rate of development to where I would consider this game playable.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏可能允许大量重复游玩，但它存在问题。

它缺乏能大幅改善游戏的基础功能，在某些方面不必要地复杂且前置内容过多。然而不知怎的又很浅薄。它缺乏关于任何东西作用的说明，比如玩家特质。

以下是一些简单的事情，我认为它需要优先处理：
无法从角色创建退出到主菜单，以防你按错了按钮或想再试一次。标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上次存档的，可能应该叫“加载”。
不知为何容器物品需要与之互动，然后你需要选择“库存”。听着，我喜欢库存管理，见鬼，我喜欢CDDA，但要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品并不好。我无法强调这减少了我多少乐趣。不得不检查每样东西的库存很乏味。
无法给物品贴标签或更改名称，你那瓶用来配咖啡的“伏特加”玻璃瓶？是啊，每次你想翻找你的东西时，都得用之前说的检查库存，因为你无法一眼看出里面是什么？
使用control从一堆物品中拾取单个物品是不可能的，你用control反而是从堆里“放置”一个？似乎反了。
在飞船上关闭飞船菜单时，会把你踢出导航面板，在你学习游戏时非常烦人，之后仍然烦人。
没有简单的方法“取消”移动命令。
飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人，试图弄清你的航向同时查看你的目标非常困难。如果以后加入更好的导航部件，这还可以原谅，但我严重怀疑银河系每艘飞船上都会有这么糟糕的UI。你甚至无法获得你所瞄准物体移动方向的预测，甚至无法获得你与目标之间的角度。

其他需要改进的地方：
原声带不太好，可以用更好的音乐。我听了一会儿就关掉了。不过第一首对角色创建来说不错。
毫无作用的特质。
物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘飞船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。
所有飞船都有相同的UI？
有些特质或技能无法训练？
玩家不清楚什么时候需要付费。
新角色没有针对费用的“缓冲”，意味着你花时间创建的第一个角色100%会白费，应该能够“预先”保存已经创建好的、拥有相同父母等的角色。
更改你的姓氏不会影响你的出身。
我得到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次，长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。为什么要分配父母呢？他们似乎丝毫不影响你的故事？角色创建选项有限，总的来说尤其是女性的选项很糟糕，我试玩了几次，有一次给了我一个女性角色，在浪费时间创建角色后我意识到它只是换了一张不同的脸，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽。但总体而言它很欠缺，你甚至无法创建一个看起来像加载画面里的角色……甚至看起来“正常”的都不行。
你飞船的贷款系统似乎有点奇怪？你可以贷款买一艘800,000美元的飞船，但不能贷款买一艘80,000美元加一些额外东西比如装备的？或者一张执照？我不知道，老兄。事情说不通，在一艘飞船的描述中提到你曾在它上面工作过……为什么你不能在最便宜的飞船上工作？
漫长的保存时间是个问题。
角色创建有时很烦人，“寻找飞船”应该
不要在你下次查看时再次显示同一艘飞船，即使这会增加更多时间。
NPC会偷你的物品？物品消失？不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。
卸载你飞船上的部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？甚至从港口也不行？


我试着享受这款游戏，因为它似乎具备了一款我会喜欢的游戏的所有元素，但至少目前它是半生不熟的，我就是不喜欢。它甚至也没那么有深度，尽管乍一看似乎很复杂，一旦你玩上一小会儿，它其实是一款非常简单的游戏。

尽管如此，我仍然认为在经过一些更新后这会是一款好游戏，不幸的是，据我所见，以目前的开发速度，至少需要3年才能达到我认为这款游戏可玩的程度。

items.text:
Very good concept and if completed will be an all-time favorite of mine. Currently, progress is very slow and bugs are plenty. Having companions doesn't work very well. Lots of animation work left to do. A deeper economy and ways to make money need to be added. There will most likely later be pirating, salvaging, hacking, persuasion, all as ways to "win" and become rich. Right now, it's very stale with progression coming down to fly to location - load up on scraps - fly to location - fix a bunch of parts - fly to location - sell parts. You'd have to do that loop probably 20 times, taking over an hour or two each time, to make enough to buy a new ship. Previously there was a bit of an oversight where you could buy a damaged ship, install high-grade parts on it, and sell it for a fortune. This has been fixed, and now derilect's aren't worth working on. Combat is very half baked at the moment, with a psuedo turn-based system where the real time will pause after both people have made a move. Right click on the enemy, try to tackle or shoot or hit or stab, RNG, they try to do the same to you, RNG, they damage your space suit, you suffocate, reload and skip that ship next time. Animations during combat make it nearly impossible to tell what is actually happening, no status indicators to help see who is winning or make strategic decisions. 

With the new update that got rid of derilect farming, I didn't get to buy a large ship and make it my own, but I had been able to previously, and it was an amazing experience. Hooking up power, ship systems, balancing oxygen and nitrogen, setting up fuel systems, designing storage, designing airlocks and failsafes, was all incredible fun, as is the salvaging. There just isn't enough variety or ability to build your craft out yet to make it an amazing game loop. If expanding your ship were easier, or faster, it would be a lot more friendly for longer hours. A system where you blueprint the craft additions and then your guy gets to work would be awesome, instead of manually and individually right clicking every part, waiting for deconstruct, waiting for install, right click, right click, press 1, press 2, right click, wait, right click, press 1, wait, press 2...... 

Overall worthy project of support.
items.text_zh:
非常好的概念，如果完成的话会成为我一生的最爱。目前，进展非常缓慢，bug 很多。同伴系统运作得不太好。还有大量动画工作要做。需要加入更深层的经济和赚钱方式。之后很可能会加入海盗、打捞、黑客、说服，所有这些作为“获胜”和致富的途径。现在，游戏非常乏味，进程归结为飞到地点——装载废料——飞到地点——修理一堆零件——飞到地点——卖掉零件。你大概得重复这个循环 20 次，每次花一两个小时，才能赚够钱买一艘新船。之前有一个小疏漏，你可以买一艘受损的船，给它装上高级零件，然后卖出一大笔钱。这个问题已被修复，现在废弃船不值得去弄了。战斗目前非常半成品，采用一种伪回合制系统，双方都行动后实时会暂停。右键点击敌人，尝试擒抱或射击或打击或刺击，随机数判定，他们尝试对你做同样的事，随机数判定，他们损坏你的太空服，你窒息，重新加载，下次跳过那艘船。战斗中的动画让人几乎无法分辨实际发生了什么，没有状态指示器来帮助看出谁占上风或做出战略决策。

随着新更新取消了废弃船刷钱，我没能买一艘大船并把它变成我自己的，但我之前曾经能够做到，那是一次奇妙的体验。接通电力、船舶系统、平衡氧气和氮气、设置燃料系统、设计存储、设计气闸和故障保险，全都极其有趣，打捞也是如此。只是目前还没有足够的多样性或能力来把你的飞船建造出来，使其成为一个出色的游戏循环。如果扩展你的飞船更容易或更快，对长时间游玩会友好得多。一个系统，你先为飞船增建设计蓝图，然后你的人开始工作，那会很棒，而不是手动逐个右键点击每个零件，等待拆解，等待安装，右键，右键，按 1，按 2，右键，等待，右键，按 1，等待，按 2……

总体而言，是一个值得支持的项目。

items.text:
おすすめしにくい面白さ
スカベンジャーとして船を解体してパーツを売るか、廃船の権利を買い取ってまともな船に直して売り払うゲーム。
宇宙の廃船を自分の船に組み込んで自分好みの船を作っていく点や、センサーを通して宇宙に繰り出す感覚は得難い体験を齎してくれる。
クルーも特性が細かく存在していて個性があって雇うのも面白い。
廃船に辿り着いてどんなお宝や脅威が待っているのかワクワクしながらドッキングするのはとっても楽しい。

一方、作業の殆どに手間と時間がかかる。
仮にほぼ無傷の船を完全解体するとすれば現実時間でも何時間か見据える必要がある。
（ちゃんと言っておくと特段の理由がなければそんなことはしない）
あんまりAIがよくないのでオートにしても効率的に動かないし（床板を一枚ずつ運ぶとか）、必要な準備を整えたところでスーツの酸素を自動で取り換えてはくれないし、機材の充電もしてくれない。
おまけに暫く目を離すとなぜかヘルメットを宇宙空間で外して窒息死してるか、ヘルメットをかぶったまま何故食事ができないのか判らないまま餓死してくれる。
そんな訳でクルーを増やすとこの辺のマイクロマネジメントを強いられるが、現状アーリーの段階では設定は期待通りに働かない。

ともかく、ハマれば時間が吹き飛ぶことは間違いないが、バグやAI関連にダレ始めると苦痛になっていく。
オススメしにくいけれど、没入感があってロールプレイングゲームとしてとても優秀。
今後のアップデートでバグやクエスト関連やUIなどの改善を切望しています
items.text_zh:
难以推荐的有趣之处
这是一款作为拾荒者拆解飞船并出售零件，或者买下废弃飞船的权利，将其修好再卖掉的游戏。
将宇宙中的废弃飞船整合进自己的飞船，打造自己中意的飞船，以及通过传感器迈向宇宙的感觉，能带来难得的体验。
船员也有细致的特点，富有个性，雇佣他们也很有趣。
抵达废弃飞船，一边兴奋地期待有什么宝藏或威胁在等着，一边对接，非常有趣。

另一方面，几乎所有的作业都费时费力。
假设要完全拆解一艘几乎无损的飞船，即使按现实时间也需要好几个小时。
（说清楚一点，除非有特别理由，否则不会那么做）
AI 不太好，所以即使设为自动也不会高效运作（比如一块一块地搬运地板），即使做好了必要的准备，也不会自动更换宇航服的氧气，也不会给设备充电。
而且，稍微一不留神，不知为何就会在宇宙空间摘下头盔窒息而死，或者戴着头盔却不知为何无法进食，就这么饿死。
因此，增加船员就会被迫进行这方面的微观管理，但在目前的抢先体验阶段，设置并不能如预期般运作。

总之，一旦沉迷其中，时间肯定会飞逝，但一旦对 bug 和 AI 相关问题开始感到厌倦，就会变成痛苦。
虽然难以推荐，但很有沉浸感，作为角色扮演游戏非常优秀。
切望今后的更新能改善 bug、任务相关和 UI 等方面

items.text:
I'm having to write a negative review for a game I'd really wish I could recommend. And I really want to recommend this. Maybe if the issues I mention get addressed, i'll revisit this review. If you're looking for a game that includes ship harvesting and ship building, I recommend Cosmoteer or Startdeus instead.

[h1]The Review - The Good Parts[/h1]
[b]1.[/b] Before I go ANY FURTHER, I was to say that the community is one of the best I've ever seen. When I posted on one of the Quill18 videos that I was two days into the game and felt like I was going to post a negative review, only one person did the gatekeeping dismissal by telling me "This game isn't for you, because it's not going to hold your hand." Everyone else either posted suggestions for me to try or commiserated over getting stuck in the game for the same and/or similar reasons. And all the comments under his videos of the game and on the internet have been the same. I know plenty of games that deserve a fanbase like this.

[b]2.[/b] Some of the game systems are quite enjoyable. So long as I didn't encounter any of the game breaking bugs and poorly thought-out features that renders playthroughs dead, I really did enjoy flying out to derelicts, breaking them down, figuring out what I could fly back (Before I expanded the ship), fixing it up, and selling it off once I got to OKLA station/K-LEG. Even playing Storage Tetris isn't a tiring exercise. Sadly, I didn't get to see other options, like the RPG elements or inter-planetary travel, mostly because issues with the game really hemmed me in to sticking with what I knew worked.

[b]3.[/b] The art in the game is great. And it looks like the dev used community created art for the loading screens and interactive story dump screen. And if I read the screens correctly, it looks like they gave the name of the work and credited the artist. (I can't say if or what the compensation was for the works. But at least they're credited.)

[b]4.[/b] Some of the mechanical choices are fun as well. The parts of the character selection screen I did enjoy was the backstory generator. Mind you, it needs a lot more work and a lot more material. But it was an interesting touch. Likewise, opening the control panels on devices to wire them up to other components was a nice touch.


[h1] The Review - The "Meh, It's Fine" Parts[/h1]
Had to remove a chunk because of character limits. Your Milage May Vary.

[h1]The Review - The Hair Ripping Parts[/h1]
[b]1.[/b] The Game Breaking Bugs and Features - When I say "Game Breaking", I'm not talking about constantly crashing to desktop or locking up so hard you have to use the Task List to kill it. Nope. The game’s fairly stable. In 105 hours of game play (as of this review), I only encountered such an issue ONCE. No, these are broken or poorly implemented features that either outright end your current run or force you to go back to an older save to avoid the issue before it became an issue. Things like your character not able to clear a condition causing your character to black out and hit the deck every five seconds because your character is blacking out and hitting the deck every five seconds. Or that the ONLY way to clear a wanted status despite paying the fine already is to get arrested and thrown in jail. Except that you're a wanted criminal scum that they've determined to shoot on sight. Mind you, the crime was not undocking from a wreck or undocking fast enough from a wreck, even though you were probably neck deep in a salvage operation and the beep for the police is the same beep as every fricken person who wants a chunk of your time. I swear it's like the Dev took the 2024 US DoJ 126 page report on the abuses of the City of Phoenix Police Department and said, "Hold mah beer!" Really don't need this level of aggression in a game when I could get it stepping outside of my house.

[b]2.[/b] This game fails to communicate and educate the player on all three levels:
[b]2.1.[/b] The Tutorial - The tutorial is just a series of pop ups in the bottom left corner of the screen. They look exactly like any other task you might get, so you don't know if it's something you should be doing or ignoring for later. And most of those boxes tell you to do something, but they don't tell you HOW to do that something. The Dev expects you to just figure it out. (Or try to locate all the poorly written manuals as PDFs... except they do a poor job of telling you about them. There's going to be a lot of "stumbling on to..." situations.) You're looking to YouTube and Reddit for tutorials. (I recommend MO Chad on YouTube. QUill18 is good because a lot of comments to his videos are telling him "How To".

[b]2.2.[/b] The Game does not follow its own design language. The game spends time setting up the experience on various systems, only to break those experiences later in the game. Take objects. Take containers. You learn early on that your backpack (a container) can be accessed by right clicking on it and selecting "Inventory". Then you find out racks (more containers) can be accessed by right clicking and then selecting "Inventory". Then you find other objects (like chargers and tools that use batteries) are containers and can be "opened up" by right clicking and selecting "Inventory". Delightfully simple system that's used everywhere... not really. Got to fill up your O2 bottle for the suit? Drop it under a vent, access the control panel, switch the panel to on, and repeat until you stop blowing up bottles. Need to fill up containers involving liquids? Put the container in your hand, then right click on the sink and look for the "Dispense Liquid" option. This inconsistency will drive you nuts.

[b]2.3.[/b] The Game's UI has a problem communicating relevant information to the player. For example, one of the game breaking features of the game is getting the Black-Out condition every 30 seconds or so. The game does not tell you how you got the condition or how to clear it. If you're lucky, either you remember being thrown violently and repeatedly to the point of getting a concussion or your sleep gauge is high and red. But even if you know how to fix the sleep issue (I'm still trying to figure out how to fix the concussion.), you may not be able to get yourself to a bed to sleep it off because you keep blacking out on the way to the bed. (By the way, the sleep mechanic is broken as well, as six hours sleep should do a number to the sleep bar.) The game does a poor job telling you that you've got a wanted status. (It's visible on the transponder, if you ever look at the transponder, then it's a beat-down and shooting by the police.) Even the status gauges don't operate the same way or communicate issues clearly. (Just watch the Quill18 series to see a veteran programmer keep questioning what the UI is saying.)

[b]3.[/b] The game has performance issues. As you play the game, the game will start bogging down. It gets to the point you will need to save your game and cycle the game to clear out the memory. (Dev. Visual Basic has garbage clearing routines. This isn't acceptable.)

Yes, this game is in Early Access. But it entered EA in Sept. 2020, and it's Sept. 2024. That's four years. And the dev's "Road Map" says the game will be released in 2025. (It's really a poster version of South Park's Underwear gnomes graphic of "Step 1. Do the thing. Step 2. ????? Step 3. Profit".) There is no excuse for a lot of these issues in a game that's been in EA for over four years, or a game that expects to release to a 1.0 version in the next year.

我不得不给一款我真心希望能推荐给大家的游戏写一篇负面评测。我真的很想推荐这款游戏。也许如果我所提到的问题得到解决，我会重新审视这篇评测。如果你在找一款包含船只拆解和船只建造的游戏，我反而推荐《Cosmoteer》或《Startdeus》。

[h1]评测——优点部分[/h1]
[b]1.[/b] 在我继续往下说之前，我想说这个社区是我见过的最好的社区之一。当我在Quill18的一个视频下留言说，我玩这游戏才两天，就觉得自己要发一篇负面评测时，只有一个人用那种守门式的轻蔑态度对我说：“这游戏不适合你，因为它不会手把手教你。”其他所有人要么给我发来可以尝试的建议，要么就和我一起吐槽因为相同和/或类似的原因卡在游戏里。而他那些游戏视频下面以及网上的所有评论也都是这样。我知道有很多游戏配得上这样的粉丝群体。

[b]2.[/b] 游戏的一些系统相当令人愉快。只要我没遇到那些让整个流程直接报废的破坏性bug和考虑不周的功能，我真的很享受飞到废弃船只那里，把它们拆解，琢磨我能带什么回去（在我扩建飞船之前），把它修好，然后等我到达OKLA空间站/K-LEG后把它卖掉。就连玩“仓库俄罗斯方块”也不是一件累人的事。遗憾的是，我没能体验到其他选项，比如RPG元素或星际旅行，主要是因为游戏的问题真的把我限制在了我知道行得通的那套玩法里。

[b]3.[/b] 游戏的美术很棒。而且看起来开发者使用了社区创作的画作作为加载界面和互动故事倾倒界面的美术。如果我读屏幕上的信息没读错的话，看起来他们给出了作品名称并标注了艺术家。（我无法说这些作品是否有报酬或报酬是什么。但至少他们被署名了。）

[b]4.[/b] 一些机制上的选择也很有趣。角色选择界面中我确实喜欢的部分是背景故事生成器。当然，它需要更多的工作和更多的素材。但这是一个有趣的细节。同样，打开设备上的控制面板把它们连接到其他组件也是一个不错的细节。


[h1] 评测——“嗯，还行吧”的部分[/h1]
因为字数限制不得不删掉一大段。你的体验可能有所不同。

[h1]评测——让人抓狂的部分[/h1]
[b]1.[/b] 破坏游戏的bug和功能——当我说“破坏游戏”时，我不是在说不断崩溃到桌面或者卡死到必须用任务列表来杀掉它。不。游戏相当稳定。在105小时的游戏时间中（截至这篇评测），我只遇到过一次这样的问题。不，我说的是那些要么直接终结你当前这局游戏，要么迫使你回到较早的存档、在问题变成问题之前就避开它的那些损坏或实现糟糕的功能。比如你的角色无法清除某个状态，导致你的角色每五秒就昏过去并摔倒在地，因为你的角色每五秒就昏过去并摔倒在地。或者，尽管你已经付了罚款，清除通缉状态的唯一方法却是被逮捕并扔进监狱。只不过你是个被通缉的罪犯渣滓，他们认定要见到就开枪。请注意，罪行不是从一艘废弃船只上脱离停靠，或者从一艘废弃船只上脱离停靠得不够快，即使你当时很可能正深陷打捞作业之中，而警察的提示音和每一个想占用你时间的该死的家伙的提示音是同一个声音。我发誓这就像开发者拿来了2024年美国司法部关于凤凰城警察局滥用职权的那份126页报告，然后说：“扶好我的啤酒！”我真的不需要在一款游戏里体验这种程度的攻击性，我走出家门就能遇到。

[b]2.[/b] 这款游戏在三个层面上都未能向玩家传达信息和进行教学：
[b]2.1.[/b] 教程——教程只是屏幕左下角的一系列弹窗。它们看起来和你可能接到的任何其他任务一模一样，所以你根本不知道这是你该做的事还是该忽略留到以后做的事。而且这些框大多告诉你要做某件事，却不告诉你该怎么做那件事。开发者指望你自己琢磨出来。（或者试着去找那些写得糟糕的PDF手册……只不过他们在告诉你这些手册存在这件事上做得很差。会有很多“偶然发现……”的情况。）你只能去YouTube和Reddit找教程。（我推荐YouTube上的MO Chad。QUill18也不错，因为他视频下的很多评论都在告诉他“怎么做”。

[b]2.2.[/b] 游戏不遵循自己的设计语言。游戏花时间在各种系统上建立起一套体验，结果却在游戏后期打破这些体验。拿物品来说。拿容器来说。你很早就学到，你的背包（一个容器）可以通过右键点击它并选择“物品栏”来访问。然后你发现货架（更多容器）可以通过右键点击然后选择“物品栏”来访问。然后你发现其他物品（比如充电器和用电池的工具）也是容器，可以通过右键点击并选择“物品栏”来“打开”。令人愉快地简单的系统，到处都在用……才不是呢。要给宇航服充满氧气瓶？把它放在通风口下面，访问控制面板，把面板切换到开启，然后重复直到你不再把瓶子炸掉。需要给装液体的容器加满？把容器拿在手里，然后右键点击水槽，寻找“分配液体”选项。这种不一致会把你逼疯。

[b]2.3.[/b] 游戏的UI在向玩家传达相关信息方面有问题。例如，游戏中一个破坏游戏的功能是大约每30秒就获得一次“昏厥”状态。游戏不告诉你你是怎么得到这个状态的，也不告诉你如何清除它。如果你运气好，要么你记得自己被猛烈地反复摔来摔去直到脑震荡，要么你的睡眠条很高而且是红色的。但即使你知道如何解决睡眠问题（我还在努力弄清楚怎么治脑震荡。），你也可能无法把自己弄到床上去睡一觉来消除它，因为你在去床上的路上不断昏过去。（顺便说一句，睡眠机制也是坏的，因为睡六个小时应该对睡眠条有很大影响。）游戏在告诉你你处于通缉状态这件事上做得很差。（它在应答器上可见，如果你会去看应答器的话，然后就是被警察暴打和开枪。）就连状态条也不以相同的方式运作，或者清晰地传达问题。（只要看看Quill18的系列视频，就能看到一位资深程序员不断质疑UI在说什么。）

[b]3.[/b] 游戏有性能问题。随着你玩下去，游戏会开始变得卡顿。它会到那种你需要保存游戏并重启游戏来清理内存的地步。（开发者。Visual Basic有垃圾清理例程。这是不可接受的。）

items.text:
I wish there was a middle-ground review option beyond yes/no. This game has a really interesting premise, unfortunately marred by some very frustrating design decisions.

TLDR: Pretty frustrating to play right now, but a ton of great worldbuilding and a great art style. With some UX improvements, this could become a phenomenal game.

The fully diegetic interfaces are pretty opaque in terms of communicating gameplay functions. Tooltips are nowhere to be found. The interfaces are clearly crafted with a lot of care for the game's universe, but from a game design perspective, it falls short of creating a cohesive experience. Often it feels detached from the core gameplay of exploring and salvaging, like you've got to "deal with" using these opaque interfaces to get to the parts of the game that are actually fun.

Inventory and item management are pretty rough IMO. Nothing has tooltips, and what your character has equipped is handled with a single paper doll, with very little feedback about how things can be equipped or managed. This is solveable, but in it's current state, the UX left a lot to be desired.

Building & crafting also confused me. From the start, you have a HUGE catalog of things you can build. But why is everything unlocked from the start? You're telling me my 20 year old asthmatic ship salvager also *happens* to know how to build 12 different kinds of bulkhead storage bin? Furthermore, the crafting loop is pretty opaque too. Blueprints can be placed, but there was no clear way to actually craft things from what I could tell.

The core point of my review is that *more feedback to the user is essential.* Let the **consequences** of gameplay remain hardcore AF. Just give the user more information about what actions can be taken, and maybe rework the crafting loop to be more incrementally unlocked and guided.
items.text_zh:
我希望除了“是/否”之外，还能有一个折中的评测选项。这款游戏有一个非常有趣的前提设定，可惜被一些极其令人沮丧的设计决策给毁了。

长话短说：目前玩起来相当令人沮丧，但世界观构建非常出色，美术风格也很棒。如果能改进一些用户体验，这可能会成为一款现象级的游戏。

完全叙事内化的界面在传达玩法功能方面相当晦涩。提示框根本找不到。这些界面显然是为了游戏宇宙而精心打造的，但从游戏设计的角度来看，它未能营造出连贯统一的体验。很多时候，它感觉与探索和打捞的核心玩法脱节，就好像你不得不“忍受”使用这些晦涩的界面，才能到达游戏中真正有趣的部分。

在我看来，物品栏和物品管理相当粗糙。什么都没有提示框，你的角色装备了什么只靠一个纸娃娃来呈现，关于如何装备或管理物品的反馈极少。这是可以解决的，但在目前的状态下，用户体验还有很多不足之处。

建造和制作也让我很困惑。从一开始，你就有一个巨大的可建造物品目录。但为什么所有东西从一开始就解锁了？你是说，我这个20岁患有哮喘的飞船打捞员，还*恰好*知道怎么建造12种不同的舱壁储物箱？此外，制作循环也相当晦涩。蓝图可以放置，但据我所知，并没有明确的方法真正用它们来制作东西。

我评测的核心观点是，*给用户更多反馈至关重要。* 让玩法的**后果**保持硬核到爆。只要给用户更多关于可以采取哪些行动的信息，也许再重新设计一下制作循环，让它以更循序渐进的方式解锁并提供引导。

items.text:
Edit: As of April 2025, the game continues to improve on a lot of the systems I talk about, including a much better tutorial than what was present when I reviewed it.

[b]Short version review[/b]: Ostranauts blends together elements from niche games like SS13/Starsector/Delta-V Rings of Saturn/Neo Scavenger/Rimworld into a wholly new style of space salvaging game. If you have ever played Space Station 13 and enjoy the learning curve, you will be easily addicted to this game. Bugs are relatively infrequent in my play-through, but many of the game's unique and skeumorphic controls are counter-intuitive in ways that may confuse a beginner player. It's really good, but the number one thing the game needs to improve is a stronger, longer tutorial and adding regular tool-tips that clarify points of common confusion. [b]The game is absolutely worth buying in the current version, but you should join the Blue Bottle Games Discord so that you can ask people questions if you need help. They are nice folks too.[/b]

[b]Long-winded version review[/b]: Ostranauts is a derelict space ship salvaging game that blends a mix of elements that worked really well in other cult-classic modern games. In each case, the game implements them in a wholly unique way, and I'm drawing the comparisons here mainly to give an idea of what the mechanics are like to someone who has never played before. Specifically, the ship building, deconstruction, and meticulous atmospheric/electrical simulation are a lot like Space Station 13. The setting, economic simulation, and aesthetics are a lot like Starsector. The ship piloting, Newtonian physics, and realistic simulation of fuel economy are a lot like Delta-V Rings of Saturn. The way that the hand-crafted open world, inventory, action, and dialog systems work is a lot like Neo Scavenger (another game made by the same devs). And the ability to pause/speed-up time and manage multiple crew members through assigned actions and schedules is similar to Rimworld or Dwarf Fortress (more so the former). 

The game introduces a lot of mechanics that are brand-new concepts for this type of game. When you start out, you build your character's history, skill-set, and social relations (like friends and enemies who will be present in the game world) through what's essentially a choose-your-own-adventure minigame that gradually awards your character more starting cash, skills, and history at the cost of aging your character. For instance, in my first play-through, I built a character that was 28 years old, skilled in hacking, electrical engineering, and armed combat (the latter through betraying a criminal that won my character more starting cash and skills but gave me an enemy). I much later had that enemy board my ship and try to kill me. It is similar to how Mount & Blade's character story creation works, but Ostranauts does it better and with greater depth and consequences.

You start the game dirt-poor, with a hefty mortgage on your ship, space station docking fees to pay at the end of the shift, and a lousy pressure suit that can't even fit an oxygen tank (effectively an air-tight fish bowl you can use to prevent death in zero pressure which stores exactly as much air as the suit and helmet holds). The game starts on a planetoid-bound space station called "OKLG" governed by a hyper-capitalist, corporatorist, dystopian, etc government. You un-dock your ship from the space station and point the thrusters towards a nearby derelict (with instructions provided on a hand-written piece of paper stuffed into the bottom of your nav console). After a brief docking mini-game, you can board the derelict ship through the airlock and plunder all of its stowed loot. Anything on, inside, or a part of the ship can be ripped out by your character and sold for cash back at OKLG. This process of visiting a derelict, looting it, and bringing back your spoils to sell is the main game loop. Gradually, you will acquire a proper space suit, a gun to shoot pirates, and other hired crew members to split the labor of repairing your ship and stripping loot from derelicts. 

Much like piloting a real space ship (or what I can assume it is like), the game gives few safeguards to prevent you from killing yourself if you do something stupid. If you uninstall the floor fuselage of your ship, the entire atmosphere will vent out into space and suffocate you. If you attempt to fire your thrusters at full strength while docked to a derelict or station, your ship will rip itself apart (although the game will briefly warn you beforehand with a big red flashing message). If you are harvesting your first derelict with only the lousy pressure suit and let your oxygen run out, you will pass out and die. If you get stopped by the space-cops for salvaging without a license and try to kick them off your ship, they will ram your ship. If you do not regularly maintain parts of your ship, a vital piece will break at just the wrong moment and wipe out both your power and atmospherics.

In its present state, the game has a lot of depth and more than enough content for the price point. It is quite stable and has only occasional bugs and no crashes in my current play-through of ~8hrs. What's planned in the roadmap is really exciting and development seems to be ongoing with major updates coming out roughly every half a year. Understanding the jankiness of the space ship controls and game mechanics is part of the fun (and eventually everything makes sense), but the game doesn't really offer an ample tutorial for a new player to learn how everything works. Unlike Space Station 13, which has an extensive community-curated wiki that can fill in the blanks on especially obtuse mechanics, Ostranauts only has word of mouth. For that reason, I highly recommended that you join the Discord for Blue Bottle Games where friendly players can offer help if you get stuck or confused. The developers must eventually flesh out the tutorials and instructions to have the game reach a wider audience and get better reviews. However, what they have already built is a spectacularly unique game that's worth the effort of learning to play - even if you have to ping someone on Discord to figure out what a button does.
items.text_zh:
编辑：截至2025年4月，游戏在我提到的许多系统上持续改进，包括比我在评测时存在的教程要好得多的教程。

[b]简短版评测[/b]：Ostranauts将SS13/Starsector/Delta-V Rings of Saturn/Neo Scavenger/Rimworld等小众游戏的元素融合成一种全新的太空打捞游戏风格。如果你玩过《太空站13》并且喜欢那种学习曲线，你会很容易对这款游戏上瘾。在我的游玩过程中，bug相对不频繁，但游戏许多独特且拟物化的操作方式在某种程度上反直觉，可能会让新手玩家感到困惑。它真的很棒，但游戏最需要改进的头号事项是更强大、更长的教程，并添加常规的工具提示来澄清常见的困惑点。[b]当前版本的游戏绝对值得购买，但你应该加入Blue Bottle Games的Discord，这样在需要帮助时可以问别人问题。他们也是很好的人。[/b]

[b]啰嗦版评测[/b]：Ostranauts是一款废弃飞船打捞游戏，融合了在其他邪典经典现代游戏中非常奏效的多种元素。在每一种情况下，游戏都以完全独特的方式实现它们，我在这里做比较主要是为了让从未玩过的人了解这些机制是什么样的。具体来说，飞船建造、拆解以及细致的大气/电力模拟很像《太空站13》。设定、经济模拟和美学很像《Starsector》。飞船驾驶、牛顿物理学以及燃料经济的真实模拟很像《Delta-V Rings of Saturn》。手工打造的开放世界、物品栏、动作和对话系统的运作方式很像《Neo Scavenger》（同一开发商制作的另一款游戏）。而暂停/加速时间以及通过分配行动和日程来管理多名船员的能力则类似于《Rimworld》或《Dwarf Fortress》（更偏向前者）。

游戏引入了许多对这类游戏而言全新概念的机制。开始时，你通过本质上是一个选择你自己的冒险小游戏来构建角色的历史、技能组合和社会关系（比如会出现在游戏世界中的朋友和敌人），这个小游戏会逐渐奖励你的角色更多起始现金、技能和历史，代价是让你的角色变老。例如，在我的第一次游玩中，我构建了一个28岁的角色，擅长黑客、电气工程和武装战斗（后者是通过背叛一名罪犯获得的，这为我的角色赢得了更多起始现金和技能，但给了我一个敌人）。很久之后，那个敌人登上了我的飞船并试图杀我。这类似于《骑马与砍杀》的角色故事创建方式，但Ostranauts做得更好，深度和后果也更强。

你开始游戏时一贫如洗，飞船上有沉重的抵押贷款，轮班结束时还要支付空间站停靠费，还有一套糟糕的增压服，甚至装不下氧气罐（实际上就是一个气密的鱼缸，你可以用它来防止在零压力下死亡，它储存的空气量正好等于增压服和头盔所能容纳的量）。游戏开始于一个绑定在小行星上的空间站，名为“OKLG”，由一个超级资本主义、社团主义、反乌托邦等等的政府管理。你将飞船从空间站脱离，把推进器指向附近的一艘废弃飞船（导航控制台底部塞着一张手写纸条，上面提供了说明）。经过一个简短的对接小游戏后，你可以通过气闸登上废弃飞船，掠夺所有存放的战利品。飞船上、飞船内或作为飞船一部分的任何东西都可以被你的角色拆下来，带回OKLG卖钱。这种访问废弃飞船、掠夺它、把战利品带回来出售的过程就是主要游戏循环。逐渐地，你会获得一套合适的太空服、一把用来射击海盗的枪，以及其他雇佣船员来分担修理飞船和从废弃飞船剥离战利品的工作。

就像驾驶真正的太空飞船一样（或者我猜测的那样），如果你做了蠢事，游戏几乎没有保护措施来防止你害死自己。如果你卸下飞船的地板机身，整个大气会排放到太空中，让你窒息。如果你在停靠于废弃飞船或空间站时试图全功率点燃推进器，你的飞船会把自己撕裂（尽管游戏会事先用一条大大的红色闪烁消息短暂警告你）。如果你只穿着糟糕的增压服打捞你的第一艘废弃飞船，并让氧气耗尽，你会昏倒并死亡。如果你因无证打捞而被太空警察拦下，并试图把他们踢下你的飞船，他们会撞你的飞船。如果你不定期维护飞船的部件，一个关键部件会在最糟糕的时刻损坏，摧毁你的电力和大气系统。

在目前的状态下，游戏有很深的深度，并且对于这个价格来说内容绰绰有余。它相当稳定，在我目前约8小时的游玩中只有偶尔的bug，没有崩溃。路线图中计划的内容非常令人兴奋，开发似乎也在持续进行，大约每半年推出重大更新。理解飞船控制和游戏机制的粗糙感是乐趣的一部分（最终一切都会说得通），但游戏并没有真正为新玩家提供充足的教程来学习一切如何运作。与《太空站13》不同，后者有社区维护的详尽wiki可以填补特别晦涩机制的空白，而Ostranauts只有口口相传。因此，我强烈建议你加入Blue Bottle Games的Discord，友好的玩家可以在你卡住或困惑时提供帮助。开发者最终必须充实教程和说明，才能让游戏触达更广泛的受众并获得更好的评价。然而，他们已经构建出的是一款极其独特的游戏，值得付出学习游玩的努力——即使你不得不在Discord上@某人来弄清楚一个按钮是做什么的。
（说明写在一张手写的纸上，塞在你的导航控制台底部）。经过一个简短的对接小游戏后，你可以通过气闸登上那艘废弃飞船，掠夺它所有存放的物资。飞船上、飞船内或作为飞船一部分的任何东西都可以被你的角色拆下来，带回OKLG卖钱。这个造访废弃飞船、掠夺它、然后把战利品带回来出售的过程就是主要的游戏循环。渐渐地，你会获得一套像样的太空服、一把用来射击海盗的枪，以及其他雇佣的船员来分担修理飞船和从废弃飞船上拆解物资的工作。

items.text:
I would not recommend currently. Clunky controls, no explanations in any meaningful way, UI elements that should exist don't. When something doesn't work there is no explanation of why you would be unable to do whatever it is what you were trying to do. For example I tried building a bed, it just wouldn't, there is no info on why i could not, it doesn't show material i would need to do the build. Same when you are repairing or restoring things. There is no info about what skills or traits actually affect any part of what you can do. The gig system is really clunky. So in the eight hours I made 3 or 4 characters trying to figure things out, I was able to get a small passenger ship and I figured how to repair and restore the entire ship. Took awhile, but when i was ready I could not figure out how to pick up passengers. The inventory system is similar to Project Zomboid with the addition of dragging things (which I like.) 

Some Good things though, the AI of the character is pretty good. It will search for the right tool and materiel when repairing or restoring when putting it on Auto Behavior. I think it also will eat or drink automatically. There is a Tag system which indicates certain things which was a bit helpful, for the character it wasn't great all of the characters I made had like 30 different tags so it was confusing, The ability to make a ship is cool, I personally would have preferred during the life timeline you for your "Resume" that you could be collecting parts to build your own tiny ship and then you can build up from there. Doing that would teach you about each part and what and how to set up each of the ships. Cause it's weird that you spend 10 years or so as a ship breaker and you don't know about the parts of the ship and what they do. 

I feel like with more time this will be an amazing game. It's just needs some of the clunk taken off (the navigation system would be one that could be a bit more streamlined, you are in the future so it doesn't need to be so complicated to fly the ship.)
items.text_zh:
目前我不推荐。操作笨拙，没有任何有意义的解释，应该存在的UI元素却不存在。当某些东西不工作时，没有解释为什么你无法做你正在尝试做的事情。例如，我尝试建造一张床，就是不行，没有信息说明为什么我不能，它不显示我建造所需的材料。修理或恢复东西时也一样。没有信息说明哪些技能或特质实际影响你能做的任何部分。零工系统真的很笨拙。所以在我玩的八小时里，我创建了3到4个角色试图弄清楚事情，我能够获得一艘小型客船，并且我弄明白了如何修理和恢复整艘船。花了一段时间，但当我准备好时，我无法弄清楚如何接乘客。库存系统类似于Project Zomboid，增加了拖拽物品的功能（我喜欢这个）。

不过有些好的方面，角色的AI相当不错。在修理或恢复时，当设置为自动行为时，它会寻找正确的工具和材料。我认为它也会自动吃喝。有一个标签系统，指示某些东西，这有点帮助，对于角色来说不是很好，我创建的所有角色都有大约30个不同的标签，所以很混乱。建造船只的能力很酷，我个人更希望在生活时间线中，你的“简历”可以收集零件来建造你自己的微型船，然后你可以从那里开始建造。这样做会教你每个部件以及如何设置每艘船。因为很奇怪的是，你作为拆船工工作了大约10年，却不知道船的部件以及它们的作用。

我觉得如果有更多时间，这将是一款很棒的游戏。只是需要去掉一些笨拙之处（导航系统可以更精简一些，你是在未来，所以飞行船只不需要那么复杂。）

items.text:
Edit: After continually seeing updates, I decided to reproach this game and retry.. My initial complaints are all around the tutorial which is fundamentally there to describe these important facts to the user.  A left click is to select and object, clicking upon an object, will pop up one or more 'containers' (inventory dialogs), right clicking is for a contextual menu of actions that the user can do on said object.  What makes the above confusing is that it's introduced at the same time as the tutorial popups, it's hard to distinguish the tutorial popups from the container popups,  and that the floor is considered a 'container' (which for a middle aged stoner was something very challenging to comprehend)

Anyways, for me, once I understood the above, the experience changed for me and I regret my earlier review which was posted out of frustration and a misunderstanding of the interface. 


=================================================

I feel anxious when I play this game because the non standard interface (which IMO is usually standard in top  down isometric strategic titles) frustrates me to the point that I can't even figure out how to complete the tutorial.  I fail to see how this game will succeed unless more effort is put into the tutorial in explaining the non standard interface or that the interface is brought up to today's norms... I saw youtubers play and warn about the interface as well but I purchased anyways believing that it would be a minor irritation.. it's not..
items.text_zh:
编辑：在持续看到更新后，我决定重新审视这个游戏并重试。我最初的抱怨全都围绕教程，教程从根本上是为了向用户描述这些重要事实。左键点击是选择对象，点击对象会弹出一个或多个“容器”（物品栏对话框），右键点击是上下文菜单，用户可以对所述对象执行操作。让上述内容令人困惑的是，它与教程弹窗同时出现，很难区分教程弹窗和容器弹窗，而且地板被认为是一个“容器”（对于一个中年瘾君子来说，这是非常难以理解的）

总之，对我来说，一旦我理解了上述内容，体验就改变了，我后悔我早先的评论，那是在沮丧和对界面误解的情况下发布的。


=================================================

我玩这个游戏时感到焦虑，因为非标准界面（在我看来，通常是俯视等距战略游戏的标准）让我沮丧到甚至无法弄清楚如何完成教程。我看不出这个游戏如何能成功，除非在教程中投入更多努力来解释非标准界面，或者将界面提升到今天的标准……我看到YouTuber玩并警告界面问题，但我还是买了，相信那会是个小烦恼……并不是……

items.text:
This game is WAY freaking cool. Its also one of the only games ive ever wanted multiplayer.
But damn its buggy. like palmetto season, like an Egyptian curse, ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ locust swarms.

Creating vibes in a video game is difficult, but damn i do feel like im an Ostranuat with this game...
This game is super hard sci-fi and heavy in detail. I was surprised at how quickly i picked everything up, given its complexity i thought i was going to have a harder time tbh, but its all fairly intuitive. Hardest thing for me is telling one pixel from another... Objects can stack which just blends it all together, making a mess of the screen.

Also its ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hard... I mean like, you can spend several hours getting your ♥♥♥♥ together to simply get stuck. I still dont really know how to play the game tbh.
Given all the game breaking bugs, I would heavily suggest the devs make custom difficulties available, ranging from needs, fines to fuel and a better tutorial. Also cheats, while i agree they ruin games, but ending a run because of bugs is even worse. I would also love to see more accessibility options. Like color blindness, and more and better overlays.
There were several notable bugs, some game breaking.
Eg. when you save your game, you have no idea at what point its saved. So you can loose 10 mins of game play when you reload the game.
There was a power glitch when i ran unbuilt cable, it still connected the power. The game thought those cables existed when they were not built yet.
I tried to repair a power generator, added all components but it would not repair past 99.99%.
Sometimes when uninstalling something, the item will disapear. Which can be devastating.

If the devs clean up the bugs, this could easily be one of my favorite space games.

这款游戏简直酷毙了。它也是我唯一想要多人模式的游戏之一。
但该死的，它bug太多了。就像棕榈季节，就像埃及诅咒，♥♥♥♥♥♥♥蝗虫群。

在电子游戏里营造氛围很难，但该死的，玩这款游戏时我真觉得自己是个Ostranuat……
这款游戏是超级硬科幻，细节繁重。我很惊讶自己这么快就上手了，考虑到它的复杂性，我以为会更难，说实话，但一切都相当直观。对我来说最难的是分辨一个像素和另一个像素……物体可以堆叠，这就把它们全混在一起，把屏幕弄得一团糟。

而且它真他妈的难……我的意思是，你可以花好几个小时把你的♥♥♥♥整理好，结果只是卡住。说实话，我到现在还不太知道这游戏该怎么玩。
鉴于所有这些破坏游戏的bug，我强烈建议开发者提供自定义难度，范围从需求、罚款到燃料，以及更好的教程。还有作弊，虽然我同意作弊会毁掉游戏，但因为bug而结束一局更糟。我也很想看到更多无障碍选项。比如色盲，以及更多更好的覆盖层。
有几个值得注意的bug，有些会破坏游戏。
例如，当你保存游戏时，你根本不知道它保存在哪个时间点。所以当你重新加载游戏时，可能会丢失10分钟的游戏进度。
当我铺设未建成的电缆时出现了一个电力故障，它仍然连接了电力。游戏以为那些电缆存在，而它们其实还没建好。
我试图修理一台发电机，添加了所有组件，但它就是无法修过99.99%。
有时卸载某样东西时，物品会消失。这可能是毁灭性的。

如果开发者清理掉这些bug，这很容易成为我最喜欢的太空游戏之一。

observations.description: 保存游戏时不清楚保存点，重新加载可能丢失进度。
observations.evidence: when you save your game, you have no idea at what point its saved. So you can loose 10 mins of game play when you reload the game.
observations.evidence_zh: 当你保存游戏时，你根本不知道它是在哪个时间点保存的。所以当你重新加载游戏时，可能会损失10分钟的游戏进度。

items.text:
Its frustrating, the setting, the atmosphere is all incredible and if you feel like you can hold out it will probably be worth it. I would be lying if I didnt enjoy myself for the 13~ hours I have put in however the experience was marred by bugs and crashes and irritable ai.

I played the game on alpha release and the game doesnt feel like much has really changed. The fundamental fusion reactor you get as an end/mid game is extremely cool but it eats over 20 tons of fuel a day at almost $300,000 a day to run where the reactor itself is about $100,000 and your entire ship could be easily priced at the amount of fuel you burn in a day. I cannot tell if this is a bug or not as this has been a feature since late 2020 and the excerpts I could find from the developer have been largely unclear as to if this is intentional or not. The solution I have seen online is to turn your reactor on for bursts, which brings the other main issue of extreme micromanagement where gameplay is inventory management mixed with trying to juggle crew members between loading screens.

The early game though is incredibly solid, salvaging and choosing parts for your starter ship before finding a holy grail in tact hull for you to move into like a techno hermit crab. The dialogue with npc I think is also really well done however I would appreciate it if there were less dialogue options or at least more distinct options outside trying to fill your meters up.

Its a largely painful experience at the moment but there is still a really engaging game underneath it all.
items.text_zh:
这很令人沮丧，设定、氛围都很棒，如果你觉得自己能坚持住，那可能最终是值得的。如果我说我在投入的13~个小时里没有玩得开心，那我就是在撒谎，但这段体验被bug、崩溃和烦人的AI破坏了。

我在alpha发布时玩了这款游戏，感觉并没有太大变化。你在游戏中期/后期获得的基础聚变反应堆非常酷，但它每天消耗超过20吨燃料，运行费用接近每天30万美元，而反应堆本身大约10万美元，你整艘船的价格可能很容易就等于你一天烧掉的燃料量。我无法判断这是不是bug，因为从2020年底以来这一直是个特性，而我能找到的开发者摘录大多不清楚这是否是有意为之。我在网上看到的解决方案是让反应堆间歇性开启，这就带来了另一个主要问题：极度的微观管理，游戏玩法变成了库存管理，再加上试图在加载画面之间调度船员。

不过早期游戏非常扎实，打捞并为你的初始飞船挑选部件，然后找到一艘完好船体的圣杯，像一只科技寄居蟹一样搬进去。我认为与NPC的对话也做得非常好，但如果对话选项能少一些，或者至少除了试图填满你的仪表之外有更多不同的选项，我会很感激。

目前这总体上是一种痛苦的体验，但在这一切之下仍然有一款非常引人入胜的游戏。

observations.description: 对话选项过多且缺乏区分度
observations.evidence: I would appreciate it if there were less dialogue options or at least more distinct options outside trying to fill your meters up
observations.evidence_zh: 如果对话选项能少一些，或者至少除了试图填满你的各项数值之外能有更多不同的选项，我会很感激

items.text:
The short answer is no, not in its present state. The UI is clunky, the game play is unbalanced and it needs a good tutorial as very little is self-evident. Also, the graphics are real bad (which to be fair, I knew going into the purchase).

More details: [spoiler] Even after watching several videos on YouTube while on pause (a mistake on my part - as game playtime still accrues while paused and caused me to surpass my refund time limit of 2 hours) and playing all three ships, I still found it difficult. I either died or became delinquent on the ship's mortgage note. It's no wonder these ships become available. The previous hapless soul either dies or gets his ship repo-ed and they just present it to the next fool in line. Depending on your starting ship, you either die because your free (smallest) ship is too small (i.e. doesn't have enough oxygen and/or space to allow you to salvage long enough to get or carry enough items to cover the docking fees at the salvage base) or your bigger ship has too big of a mortgage payment and not enough time to salvage enough to pay it. Where's the fun in that?

Even using the auto-dock cheat feature to save oxygen and battery/fuel reserves, (for those like me who's poor vector piloting skills keep the flight times dangerously long), I still manage to fail. It's a bit too frustrating for me. So unless you have a lot of patience or the developer introduces some sort of level of difficulty settings (beyond just the ability to slow and speed up time), I'd avoid this game, as it does not take into account the diversity of playing skills that a purchaser of this game may have.

It would help the player to know how long an action would take and how much oxygen time the ship/suit has, so we know if attempting a particular action would cause us to die before completing the action. As it is now (If I am understanding this game correctly and have not overlooked something that a tutorial could have helped with), we have no idea (or estimate) of how long a trip takes nor how much time a particular actions takes. So' it's no wonder we fail. [/spoiler]
items.text_zh:
简短的回答是：不，以目前的状态不行。用户界面笨拙，游戏玩法不平衡，而且需要一个好的教程，因为很少有东西是不言自明的。另外，画面真的很差（公平地说，我在购买前就知道这一点）。

更多细节：[剧透] 即使在暂停时看了几个YouTube视频（这是我的失误——因为暂停时游戏时间仍在累积，导致我超过了两小时的退款时限），并且玩遍了全部三艘飞船，我仍然觉得很难。我要么死了，要么拖欠了飞船的抵押贷款。难怪这些飞船会变得可用。之前那个倒霉蛋要么死了，要么飞船被收回，然后他们就直接把它交给下一个排队的傻瓜。取决于你的起始飞船，你要么因为你的免费（最小）飞船太小而死（即没有足够的氧气和/或空间让你打捞足够长的时间，以获得或携带足够的物品来支付打捞基地的停靠费），要么你的较大飞船有太高的抵押贷款还款额，而没有足够的时间打捞足够的东西来支付它。这有什么乐趣可言？

即使使用自动停靠作弊功能来节省氧气和电池/燃料储备（对于像我这样糟糕的矢量驾驶技术使飞行时间危险地过长的人），我仍然设法失败。这对我来说有点太令人沮丧了。所以除非你有很大的耐心，或者开发者引入某种难度设置（不仅仅是能够减慢和加快时间的能力），否则我会避开这款游戏，因为它没有考虑到这款游戏的购买者可能拥有的多样化游戏技能。

如果玩家能知道一个动作需要多长时间，以及飞船/宇航服还有多少氧气时间，那会很有帮助，这样我们就知道尝试某个特定动作是否会导致我们在完成动作之前死亡。就目前而言（如果我正确理解这款游戏，并且没有忽略某个教程本可以帮助解决的问题），我们不知道（也无法估计）一次旅行需要多长时间，也不知道某个特定动作需要多长时间。所以，难怪我们会失败。[/剧透]

observations.description: 缺乏行动耗时和氧气剩余时间的提示
observations.evidence: It would help the player to know how long an action would take and how much oxygen time the ship/suit has
observations.evidence_zh: 让玩家知道一个动作需要多长时间以及飞船/宇航服还有多少氧气时间会很有帮助

items.text:
I'm giving this game a thumbs up as its got great potential I've got 22 hours played when writing this review.

I've blundered my way through managing to recover and repair one of the ships from the ship graveyard.

A tutorial that takes you though the basics of things would make this game more user friendly from the start. there is no guide to what you need on a ship first few times I took over a new ship I was stranded in space once I un-docked from my pod as i had no fuel or rcs components. I managed to get the Core started but a few switches and levers don't appear to do anything at the time of writing. 

I've also accidentally turned of the fusion core instead of charging batteries also leaving me stranded.

Also it would be nice to be able to lock doors to stop crew opening them as I've accidentally opened an internal door where I had one of my crew safe as they had no suit and my character decided to go in and take something from the room exposing the crew to void space and didn't get chance to close door before it was too late.

Sometime the character pathing isn't very clever and gets stuck, and sometimes there is a task set build something and the character doesn't do it and you can't see a reason for it.

Character attributes/feeling/environment could do with a mouse over help option as my character has just decided to give up work and just keep dong social things and now is stuck in this loop and dies every time I reload.

This may sound like a negative review but the game actually has a lot of fun bits, exploring random ships recovering parts expanding repairing your own ship, selling recovered items. 
Its a got a very good foundation that it is building on and really looking forward to more content
items.text_zh:
我给这款游戏点了赞，因为它潜力巨大。写这篇评测时我已经玩了22个小时。

我跌跌撞撞地摸索着，成功从飞船坟场中回收并修复了一艘飞船。

一个带你了解基础操作的教程会让这款游戏从一开始就更友好。游戏里没有指南告诉你一艘飞船需要什么。头几次我接管新飞船时，从我的太空舱脱离后就被困在太空中，因为我没有燃料或RCS组件。我设法启动了核心，但写这篇评测时，有几个开关和拉杆似乎没有任何作用。

我还曾不小心关掉了聚变核心而不是给电池充电，结果也让我被困住了。

另外，如果能锁门来阻止船员开门就好了，因为我曾不小心打开了一扇内部舱门，当时我有一名船员在里面很安全，因为他们没有宇航服，而我的角色却决定进去从房间里拿东西，导致船员暴露在真空太空中，还没来得及关门就为时已晚。

有时候角色的寻路不太聪明，会卡住，有时候设置了建造某物的任务，角色却不去做，你也看不出原因。

角色属性/感受/环境如果能有个鼠标悬停帮助选项就好了，因为我的角色刚刚决定放弃工作，一直做社交的事情，现在陷入了这个循环，每次我重新加载都会死。

这听起来可能像是一篇负面评测，但这款游戏其实有很多有趣的方面，探索随机飞船、回收部件、扩建修复自己的飞船、出售回收的物品。
它有一个非常好的基础，并且正在此基础上不断发展，我真的很期待更多内容。

observations.evidence_zh: 角色属性/感受/环境如果能有一个鼠标悬停帮助选项就好了

finding what you need is souly based on RnG and getting lucky with a decent ship cluster however there is still promise and i do enjoy how the start of the game works as depending on how you set up items and your character you can either be good at getting one thing or the other now currently there are a few things that can be changed first of the RCS use and control in docking is stupid finicky you can go towards the arrow only to super speed past the docking port then go back the same amount and never see it until its to late and you hit the ship so that needs to be worked on with then get fired into space when you undock and that needs to be change maybe by adding a planet or star deeper in by like i dont know 1/4 an INCH also the current way that navigation works needs some items.text_zh:
好吧，首先在我陈述任何事情之前，在你购买这款游戏之前，要明白一件事：它处于alpha阶段，不是beta也不是已发布，这是这款游戏目前的骨架，话虽如此

这款游戏现在就很棒，是的，它有bug，目前最烦人的是，如果你离开一个游戏，你就无法重新进入，除非你关闭游戏再重新打开，不过对于alpha版本来说这是意料之中的，目前价格是20美元，对于一款alpha版本的游戏来说这相当高，它目前的状态和复杂度简直疯狂，让我担心它在后续版本中会是什么样子、玩起来会怎样，因为就目前而言，从任何角度来看这都不是一款简单的游戏，你完全应该预料到在获得一个好的开局之前会失败很多很多次，因为找到你需要的东西完全基于随机数生成，以及运气好遇到一个不错的飞船集群，不过仍然有希望，我确实喜欢游戏开局的方式，因为根据你如何设置物品和你的角色，你可以擅长获取某样东西或另一样东西，目前有几件事可以改，首先是RCS的使用和对接中的控制蠢得令人抓狂，你可以朝着箭头前进，结果却以超高速冲过对接端口，然后以同样的量往回走，直到为时已晚才看到它，然后撞上飞船，所以这需要针对灵敏度进行处理，其次存档系统需要改进，第三目前进行维修的方式不对劲，老实说应该有一个伤害HUD来显示什么受损了、什么有氧气、什么正在获得氧气，以及电源连接器不在它们正在供电的地方，第四据我所知目前没有战斗系统，除了那些看起来像拦截舰的飞船，它们不会跟随你，最后最烦人的是轨道环的破事，所以当你生成时，你被放入一个随机星系，我相信目前为了alpha目的它是预设的，然而中心的太空站有一个轨道环，也就是那个绿色环，那是它围绕恒星运行的轨道路径，好吧，这个♥♥♥环有一个碰撞箱，所以对接时极其常见地会卡进那东西里，或者对接进环里，然后当你脱离对接时被弹射到太空中，这需要改变，也许可以通过在更深处添加一个行星或恒星，比如我不知道，四分之一英寸，另外目前的导航工作方式也需要一些修复，目前如果你把目标放在任何地方，除了一个固定物品，比如一艘飞船、你自己、另一艘NPC飞船或一个太空站，它会向左飞走，如果你开启了目标追踪，它会把你的屁股也一起带走，另外我不知道这是一个bug还是一个有意设计的功能，但如果你把目标追踪设置为开启，然后退出导航控制台，它会把你带到某个随机太阳系的中心，你必须缩小视图，然后找到你的星系，再放大回去

现在我会更多地玩这款游戏，并随着进展更新这篇评测，以防我发现更多东西或者有什么变化，另外如果我说的有什么不对或者我漏掉了什么，欢迎评论。

observations.description: 缺少伤害HUD，无法显示损坏、氧气和电力连接信息
observations.evidence: there honestly should be a damage hud to show you whats damage what has O2 what is getting O2 and where power connectors are not were they are powering
observations.evidence_zh: 老实说，应该有一个伤害HUD来显示什么受损、什么有O2、什么正在获得O2，以及电源连接器不在它们供电的位置。

items.text:
After much trial and error as expected by this type of game I manged to learn how some of the systems works and where to look.

While I feel the UI could use some work to make things clearer, all the information needed is there, if only in a tiny font most of the time.

The game is absolutely my type especially after a deep dive into kerbal space program, I highly recommend playing this and giving it a good hour or two before giving it judgement.

The game is hard and unforgiving but it's not unfair, every death is avoidable if being vigilant but you are going to die.

Make liberal use of the game's save system and load your save when you die, you'll be put back at an earlier save.

Some advice I can give is that, if you are doomed, do not save or quit the game. Alt f4 that ♥♥♥♥♥ and reload. You'll thank me later.

Also remember the game has a backup save in your saves folder in case you accidentally saved when doomed, make use of it.

Here's a few tips:
Doors are airtight when closed.
Walls are airtight without a floor under them.
If a room is airtight it'll say compartment, if there's a hole it'll say exterior.
Hover your mouse over every tile, stuff is hidden under each other.

Traits don't seem to matter much and a lot of content seems missing yet, like hacking minigames or some much needed QOL stuff.

This game really scratches right if you like games like Kerbal space program, Elite dangerous, neo scavenger or modded minecraft.
I can't wait until it gets more fleshed out and bugs and kinks get flattened out.
items.text_zh:
经过大量试错，正如这类游戏所预期的那样，我设法学会了某些系统如何运作以及该去哪里查看。

虽然我觉得UI可以做一些改进来让事情更清晰，但所有需要的信息都在那里，只不过大多数时候字体很小。

这款游戏绝对是我的菜，尤其是在深入玩了《坎巴拉太空计划》之后，我强烈推荐玩这个，并在做出评判之前好好玩上一两个小时。

游戏很难且毫不留情，但并不不公平，只要保持警惕，每一次死亡都是可以避免的，但你终究会死。

要充分利用游戏的存档系统，在你死的时候加载你的存档，你会被放回一个更早的存档。

我能给的一些建议是，如果你注定要完蛋了，不要保存或退出游戏。直接Alt+F4那个♥♥♥♥♥然后重新加载。你以后会感谢我的。

还要记住，游戏在你的存档文件夹里有一个备份存档，以防你在注定完蛋时不小心保存了，要利用它。

这里有一些提示：
门关闭时是气密的。
墙在没有地板的情况下也是气密的。
如果一个房间是气密的，它会显示为隔间，如果有洞，它会显示为外部。
把鼠标悬停在每一个格子上，东西会藏在彼此下面。

特质似乎不太重要，而且很多内容似乎还缺失，比如黑客小游戏或一些急需的生活质量改进。

如果你喜欢《坎巴拉太空计划》、《精英危险》、《新拾荒者》或加了模组的《我的世界》这类游戏，这款游戏真的非常对味。
我迫不及待想等它变得更充实，bug和毛病都被磨平。

items.text:
So, at the moment this isn't much fun, the interface is entirely obtuse, there are so many bugs it's hard to know if they are intended game play or actual issues.  It throws you in at the deep end, don't know the standard atmospheric pressure, tough!  Don't know the required Oxygen levels in kPa, Google it, don't know temp in K, get a converter.  Does your character have Hypoxia, who can tell, still making the same face when pressure and O2 is normal.  

So, why am I recommending this, well i think that it really could be a special game, there is something here, the sense of exploration, the sense that i am really running a space ship, the shaking when the reactor starts, the controls, not just on or off, but you have to follow a sequence.

Where from here, personally i would want even more complex systems, i want to have to follow wires and pipes back to ensure that i have coolant in the reactor otherwise it explodes / melts, I want the opportunity to explore more, bigger ships, more dangers when exploring.  On the other side I think this game really urgent needs more feedback for the player and a better / clear interface.  What would be the issue if the temp and pressure are OK to have them in Green, when not OK in Red, how about a simply status page for the character, what about an overlay showing hull or floor breaches, similar to how the electrical overlay works.

Once you have your real ship (not starting Pod), there appears to be nothing more; i am not sure what the plan is.  What i would like to see are things like trading and missions, being told to rescue ships, explore abandoned vessels, unknown dangers, like FTL.

I have uninstalled this for now, but look forward to playing again when more stable and more content.
items.text_zh:
所以，目前这游戏不太好玩，界面完全晦涩难懂，bug多到很难分辨它们是游戏设计还是真正的问题。它直接把你扔进深水区，不知道标准大气压，活该！不知道所需的氧气水平是多少千帕，自己去谷歌，不知道温度是多少开尔文，找个转换器。你的角色是否缺氧，谁知道呢，当压力和氧气正常时还是同样的表情。

那么，我为什么推荐这个，嗯，我觉得它真的可能成为一个特别的游戏，这里有些东西，探索的感觉，感觉我真的在驾驶一艘宇宙飞船，反应堆启动时的震动，控制装置，不只是开或关，而是你必须遵循一个顺序。

从这里往哪走，就个人而言，我想要更复杂的系统，我想要必须沿着电线和管道回溯，以确保反应堆里有冷却剂，否则它会爆炸/熔化，我想要有机会探索更多，更大的飞船，探索时更多的危险。另一方面，我认为这个游戏真的迫切需要给玩家更多的反馈和一个更好/更清晰的界面。如果温度和压力正常，把它们显示为绿色有什么问题，不正常时显示为红色，来一个简单的角色状态页面怎么样，来一个显示船体或地板破损的叠加层怎么样，类似于电力叠加层的工作方式。

一旦你有了真正的飞船（不是起始的逃生舱），似乎就没有更多内容了；我不确定计划是什么。我希望看到的是像贸易和任务这样的东西，被告知去救援飞船，探索废弃的船只，未知的危险，就像《FTL》那样。

我现在已经卸载了这个，但期待当它更稳定、内容更多时再玩。

items.text:
На момент выхода в ранний доступ игра не дотягивает даже до альфа версии и по сути является техническим демо, которое даже толком не может обрисовать полную концепцию итогового продукта. 

В игре по сути нечего делать. Весь геймплей состоит из стыковок с заброшенными кораблями в попытке скрутить на запчасти детали и продать их на станции, чтобы подкопить денег для того, чтобы починить один из заброшенных кораблей. Но, к сожалению, до полноценного ремонта заброшенных кораблей или нормальной торговли я не смог добраться по причине огромного количества критических багов, которые софтлочат игру. Фактически при любом виде взаимодействий с любыми игровыми объектами от людей до предметов персонаж может залипнуть по непонятной причине, после чего перестает реагировать на любые команды. Выход в главное меню и загрузка вам не поможет - извольте начать новую игру. Но есть одна маленькая деталь, если не перезапустить игру полностью, то у вас пропадет возможность взаимодействовать с окружением и вы даже не сможете выйти из стартовой комнаты. 

Ещё одной серьёзной проблемой является полное отсутствие пояснений к интерфейсу. Отсутствуют контекстные подсказки при наведении курсора. Особенно забавно это выглядит при наличии десятка статусов в меню персонажа, но при этом невозможно понять, что они определяют и на что влияет его пониженная самооценка или жесткий недотрах.

Еще более забавным является тот факт, что небольшой мини-туториал по игре находится в файле readme.txt, но не в игре. В 2020 году, да. Но справедливости ради, игра сообщает об этом в момент посадки в кресло пилота. Однако, туториал вам не очень поможет в том, чтобы понять как правильно запускается реактор, потому что некоторые пункты будут давать желаемый результат только после проведения всех манипуляций, а не в середине чек-листа. Также нет вообще описания того, что делают все эти слайдеры, тумблеры и кнопки. Просто повторяй последовательность нажатий и не задавай вопросов. 

В игре абсолютно нет разнообразия в деталях корабля: один вид пола, один вид стен, один вид батарей, один вид реактора, по одному виду датчиков давления и температуры, один вид для ВСЕХ объектов. Но тут возможно что-то будет открываться по мере прохождения, если вдруг вам повезет не словить баг интерфейса при попытке попить кофе из автомата на станции.

Игра была в разработке как минимум год, и текущая поделка в стиле "я учусь программировать тайловую игру с видом сверху", вышедшая в ранний доступ - огромнейшее разочарование, после великолепного NEO scavenger от этого же разработчика.

Ах да, на второй день выпуска в ранний доступ разрабы выкатили дорожную карту, из которой можно понять примерно то, что ждать полноценной игры не стоит в ближайшие два года, и даже накатили пару патчей, которые незначительно улучшили ситуацию, но играбельность не восстановили (а было ли что восстанавливать? Вопрос риторический).

Вывод: КАТЕГОРИЧЕСКИ НЕ ПОКУПАТЬ на данном этапе.
Обзор будет переписан, если починят игру.

P.S. такое ощущение, что вот этот кусок говна лепили на коленке абы как на отвали в последний день перед выпуском в ранний доступ примерно также, как студенты доделывают курсач в последнюю ночь перед сдачей. Это говорит о том, что либо разрабам-лентяям-рукожопам срочно нужно отчитаться перед издателем, либо весь этот проект просто попытка по быстрому срубить денег на поклонниках NEO scavenger. К сожалению, в обоих случаях - это впустую потраченные деньги. Не покупайте игры на запуске в продажу не ознакомившись с отзывами, даже если доверяете разработчикам на основании предыдущих качественных продуктов. Постскриптум был добавлен после ознакомления с другими обзорами, которые по моему мнению недостаточно описывают, на сколько всё, абсолютно всё в этой поделке сделано наплевательски к собственной работе - разрабам просто похер на то, чем они занимаются. Техническое исполнение игры выглядит так, как будто игра не тестировалась и сами разработчики её запускали в лучшем случае только для проверки запускаемости. Худшая поделка, которую когда либо видел, жалко потраченных, хоть и небольших, денег.
items.text_zh:
在进入抢先体验的那一刻，这款游戏甚至达不到 alpha 版本的水平，本质上只是一个技术演示，甚至连最终产品的完整概念都无法大致勾勒出来。

游戏里基本上无事可做。整个玩法就是与废弃飞船对接，试图拧下零件当备件，然后到空间站卖掉，好攒钱去修理其中一艘废弃飞船。但遗憾的是，由于大量让游戏软锁的严重 bug，我根本没能走到完整修理废弃飞船或正常交易那一步。实际上，无论与任何游戏对象——从人到物品——进行任何形式的互动，角色都可能因为莫名其妙的原因卡住，之后就不再对任何指令做出反应。退回主菜单再读档也帮不了你——请重新开一局吧。但有一个小细节：如果不完全重启游戏，你就会失去与周围环境互动的能力，甚至无法离开起始房间。

另一个严重问题是界面完全没有说明。鼠标悬停时没有上下文提示。尤其好笑的是，角色菜单里有十来个状态，却根本搞不明白它们到底定义了什么，以及他降低的自尊心或严重的欲求不满会影响什么。

更搞笑的是，游戏里那点迷你教程居然放在 readme.txt 文件里，而不是在游戏里。2020 年了，没错。但平心而论，游戏在你坐进驾驶座时会告诉你这件事。然而，这个教程并不能很好地帮你弄明白反应堆到底该怎么正确启动，因为有些步骤只有在完成所有操作之后才会给出想要的结果，而不是在清单进行到一半时。而且完全没有说明所有这些滑块、拨动开关和按钮是干什么的。只管重复按键顺序，别问问题。

游戏里飞船部件完全没有多样性：一种地板，一种墙壁，一种电池，一种反应堆，压力和温度传感器各一种，所有对象都只有一种外观。不过也许随着流程推进会解锁一些东西，如果你碰巧在空间站自动售货机买咖啡时没触发界面 bug 的话。

这款游戏至少开发了一年，而目前这个“我在学着编程一款俯视角瓦片游戏”风格的作品进入抢先体验——在同一个开发者那款出色的 NEO scavenger 之后，这是巨大的失望。

哦对了，在抢先体验发布的第二天，开发者就放出了路线图，从中大致可以看出，未来两年内别指望有完整的游戏；他们甚至还推了几个补丁，略微改善了状况，但并没有恢复可玩性（而且，有什么可恢复的吗？这是个反问）。

结论：现阶段绝对不要买。
如果游戏修好了，这篇评测会重写。

附言：感觉这坨屎就是在抢先体验发布前的最后一天，随便在膝盖上糊出来的，就像学生们在交作业前的最后一晚赶完课程论文一样。这说明要么是那些懒惰又手残的开发者急需向发行商交差，要么整个项目只是想借 NEO scavenger 粉丝快速捞一笔钱。遗憾的是，无论哪种情况，都是白花的钱。不要在游戏刚发售时、还没看过评测就买，即使你因为之前的优质产品而信任开发者。这个附言是在看过其他评测之后加上的，因为我认为那些评测没有充分描述出，这个作品里的一切、绝对是一切，都是多么敷衍地对待自己的工作——开发者根本不在乎自己在干什么。游戏的技术表现看起来就像它从未被测试过，开发者自己最多也只是为了检查能不能启动才运行过它。这是我见过的最烂的作品，白花了钱，虽然不多。
评论，即使你基于之前高质量的产品而信任开发者。附言是在阅读了其他评论后添加的，我认为那些评论没有充分描述，这个拙劣作品中的一切、绝对是一切，都是如何以对自己工作漠不关心的态度做出来的——开发者根本不在乎他们在做什么。游戏的技术执行看起来就像游戏从未经过测试，开发者自己最多只是为了检查能否启动才运行过它。这是我所见过的最糟糕的拙劣作品，可惜了花掉的钱，虽然不多。

items.text:
[Edit after a few more hours into the game 16 Sept 2020]

It's an open/sandbox game where you start with a simple pod with a battery and barely enough energy to a scrapyard where you'll start salvaging broken ships to expand yours.

It kinda reminds me of Barotrauma for the idea of ship complexity but with the full liberty of creation and of Hellion, for the free roaming/exploration/salvaging/navigation, both games I love.
The idea is great and allows a lot of freedom in creating your very own ship.There are interesting game mechanisms for object placement, connections, air, temperature,  electricity and so on.There seems to be quite a fair amount of randomly generated narrative, for instance at the creation of your character. 
Some panels, like the docking or the reactor, are really nice and add a lot to the immersion, I love it.
Graphics are a very poor 3d but it's a style I don't mind actually.
Thanks to the few patches of the first days, I've been able to navigate a bit and dock to the first derelicts. 
Generated randomly between another rescue pod or a large spaceship, in a poor or rather ok state.

Now, onto the very bad parts.
Even though I should be tolerant with an early access game, it is difficultly playable and very grindy.
- All actions take a lot of time, (but you can accelerate time)
- Cursor location bugs, where you need to restart the game every so often.
- Docking procedure very unclear, I understood that one, you have to face the derelict with the tip of your ship even though your airlock is at the back... Once you know
- very harsh balance where you'll grind heavy objects and sell them to get a very necessary tool at the beginning
- also, not helping, most of the derelicts are so broken that you can't even enter them at the beginning
- swapping the batteries at the beginning is a chore and you'll end unlucky by finding no derelict with reactor to recharge them on
- very little progression/objective at the moment, but I'm sure it will be corrected.
- items that you lose for no good reason
- stuffs you can't remove
- some of the sounds in this game are also kinda horrific, like proximity alarms that will not shut down when docked
- some bugs are actually favorable like infinite O2
- lack of quick options to do stuffs like undocking
- pieces of the ship that are not repaired yet with no indication
- items that you cannot place on the floor where you want and you have to keep taking and dropping them until they are where you want
- Pressure, mass, temperatures, gravity that go haywire
- and some more deadlier bugs where your ship will basically crash and be destroyed for no good reason due to bugs in undocking for instance.
The list is quite long

So basically, it feels like a game with nice game mechanics but not polished, extremely buggy and configured to be grindy with high chances of death and it questions why I'm spending time in the game. It really needs to become more friendly to the player.
I'm sure the game could become something in the end but unless you want to support the developer, to be avoided for now.

I'll likely change my mind in future updates and review this frequently

That kinda reminds me of the state of disarray that was Space Engineers at the beginning.
items.text_zh:
[在游戏里多玩几个小时后于2020年9月16日编辑]

这是一款开放/沙盒游戏，你一开始只有一个带电池的简易舱，能量勉强够你到达一个废料场，在那里你将开始打捞破损的飞船来扩展你自己的飞船。

它让我有点想起《Barotrauma》，因为飞船复杂性的理念，但拥有完全的创造自由；也让我想起《Hellion》，因为自由漫游/探索/打捞/航行，这两款游戏我都喜欢。
这个想法很棒，允许你在创建自己飞船时拥有很大的自由。对于物体放置、连接、空气、温度、电力等，都有有趣的游戏机制。似乎有相当数量的随机生成的叙事，例如在你创建角色时。
有些面板，比如对接或反应堆，真的很好，大大增加了沉浸感，我很喜欢。
画面是非常糟糕的3D，但这其实是一种我不介意的风格。
多亏了最初几天的几个补丁，我已经能够稍微航行一下，并对接到最初的几艘废弃飞船。
它们是在另一个救援舱或一艘大型飞船之间随机生成的，状态很差或还算可以。

现在，来说说非常糟糕的部分。
尽管我应该对一款抢先体验游戏保持宽容，但它很难玩，而且非常肝。
- 所有动作都要花很多时间，（但你可以加速时间）
- 光标位置bug，你需要时不时重启游戏。
- 对接程序非常不清楚，我搞明白了那一个，你必须用你飞船的尖端面对废弃飞船，尽管你的气闸在后方……一旦你知道了
- 非常严苛的平衡，你一开始得肝沉重的物体并把它们卖掉，才能得到一个非常必要的工具
- 而且，更糟的是，大多数废弃飞船破损得太严重，一开始你甚至无法进入它们
- 一开始更换电池是件苦差事，而且你会很不走运地发现没有一艘废弃飞船有反应堆可以给它们充电
- 目前进展/目标非常少，但我相信这会被修正。
- 你会无缘无故失去的物品
- 你无法移除的东西
- 这款游戏里有些声音也有点可怕，比如接近警报在对接后不会关闭
- 有些bug实际上是有利的，比如无限氧气
- 缺少快速执行诸如解除对接之类操作的选项
- 飞船尚未修复的部分没有任何指示
- 你无法把物品放在地板上你想要的位置，你必须不停地拿起又放下，直到它们到了你想要的位置
- 压力、质量、温度、重力会失控
- 还有一些更致命的bug，比如由于解除对接时的bug，你的飞船基本上会无缘无故坠毁并被摧毁。
这个清单相当长

所以基本上，感觉像是一款游戏机制不错但未经打磨、bug极多，并且被配置成很肝、死亡几率很高的游戏，这让我质疑自己为什么要花时间在这游戏里。它真的需要对玩家更友好一些。
我相信这款游戏最终可能会有所成就，但除非你想支持开发者，否则目前还是避开为好。

在未来的更新中我可能会改变想法，并经常重新评测

这让我有点想起《Space Engineers》刚开始时那种混乱状态。

items.text: Messed around with this game for about an hour, still have no clue what im doing. Why am i hearing beeping? Why is my battery reserve lowering? Also i don't have any task, it just tells me to check my inventory, which i did and the task still doesn't go away. I'm just thrown into the mix and expected what to do. Also the flying mechanic makes me want to scream and i still just end up crashing into things and am forced to restart, please to god make the flying idiot proof.  I loved Neo Scavenger a lot, and was really excited for this game but i can't recommend it right now, it just needs a bit of work.
items.text_zh: 玩了大约一个小时这个游戏，仍然完全不知道我在做什么。为什么我听到哔哔声？为什么我的电池储备在下降？而且我没有任何任务，它只是告诉我去检查我的库存，我检查了，任务仍然没有消失。我就这样被扔进混战里，还被期望知道该做什么。还有飞行机制让我想尖叫，我最终还是撞到东西上并被迫重新开始，求求老天让飞行变得傻瓜式简单。我非常喜欢Neo Scavenger，对这款游戏真的很兴奋，但我现在不能推荐它，它只是需要一点打磨。
